raw.description:
Join the Intelance associate panel. The first engagement starts in late October 2026, subject to client approval.

Intelance is a UK advisory firm working on technology governance, cyber security and data governance. We are looking for an experienced data protection consultant to help a UK non-profit get the data protection terms for its online supply chain platform right. The platform has users in the UK, Europe, the US and Asia, including China. You will work with an Intelance engagement partner, and the client's own solicitors will approve the final legal wording.

Tasks

  • Review the data protection and security sections of the platform's terms of use, and redraft them so they are clear and consistent.

  • Set out the client's position as data controller when users in other countries can see data that is stored in the EU, and the safeguards it needs.

  • Check the supplier's data processing agreement against how the platform is really used.

  • Write plain English answers to the data protection questions that platform users keep asking.

  • Prepare a short list of points for the client's UK solicitor to confirm, and work alongside a law firm that is advising on China's data protection law.

  • Hand over cleanly to the Intelance colleague who will update the client's data security policy.

Requirements

  • 5 years or more working in data protection or privacy, as a consultant, data protection officer or in-house adviser.

  • Hands on experience of international data transfers under UK GDPR and EU GDPR, including Standard Contractual Clauses, the UK International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum, and transfer risk assessments.

  • You have reviewed or drafted terms of use, data processing agreements or privacy notices for a software platform.

  • A recognised qualification such as CIPP/E or the BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection.

  • You write short, clear documents that people outside legal and IT can act on.

  • Right to work in the UK, and able to work through your own limited company or as a self-employed contractor.

  • Desirable: working knowledge of China's Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL).

  • Desirable: experience with charities, standards or certification bodies, or supply chain platforms.

Benefits

  • Day rate of £500 to £625, depending on experience.

  • About 2 days of work over the first 2 weeks, with a short follow-up if the client's solicitor raises points.

  • Fully remote within the UK, with flexible hours.

  • Contract role through your own limited company or as a self-employed contractor. We expect it to fall outside IR35, and we confirm this before you start.

  • A place on the Intelance associate panel for future data governance work.

Apply with your CV and answer the short screening questions. It takes about five minutes.

We reply to every applicant within three working days. If you are shortlisted, you will have a 30 minute call with us. You join the panel once you sign our panel agreement and NDA. Please do not apply through an agency.

We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

The Role

We are in search of exceptional product marketing talent to help us promote highly scalable, true multitenant cloud solutions that are significantly impacting life sciences. Our focus is on customer satisfaction, employee success, and growth.

The Product Marketing Manager / Senior Manager – Commercial Content will be responsible for driving content and messaging for Commercial Content.     • Lead product and feature launch content creation and processes

    • Excellent writing and powerpoint skills

    • Strong project management skills with attention to detail
    • Fast learner, and must enjoy fast-paced work environments
    • Proven ability to build relationships with other teams and stakeholders

Category: Education

HNO6005- Complex Care Coordination

As an experienced online educator, the candidate will work as an independent contractor of LINC Education to offer online facilitation services for students studying in theMasters of Nursing (Online) offered by Victoria University Online. Candidate must possess strong knowledge of complex care coordination and person-centred care, with the ability to apply evidence-based frameworks, evaluate models of care, and navigate legal, ethical, and cultural considerations. Proficiency in collaborating across services, managing chronic conditions, and utilising technology for care planning is essential.

Key Skills Required

  • Safety awareness

  • Care Plan Management

  • Care giving, empathy, and compassion

  • First Aid

  • Mobility and dexterity assistance

  • Therapy and rehabilitation

  • Patient-centred care

  • Care transitions

Desired Candidate Profile

  • Registered Nurse or Midwife (AHPRA registration) or Registered Mental Health Practising Nurse and knowledge of unit content.

  • PhD and/or Master Degree in Nursing or relevant field (i.e. health-related) plus 5 years' relevant teaching, research and/or professional experience at the PG level in the last 10 years

  • Full rights to work within Australia.

  • An Australian Business Number or ABN as a sole trader, or of the entity that will contract with LINC.

  • Empathetic, ambitious, warm and outgoing personality willing to work closely with people from diverse cultures;

  • Proficient in English language; excellent oral and written communication

  • Must possess a working laptop and have access to high-speed (>10 MBPS) stable internet connection;

  • Ability to quickly learn and use technology platforms for interacting with students, including the host university’s LMS and LINCtrac (training on these platforms will be provided).

The candidate needs to be available between 5 pm to 10 pm every day.

Roles & Responsibilities

LINC Fellows will be responsible for providing:

  1. Subject matter guidance to a group of 25-30 undergraduate online students;

  2. Support in learning skills like academic writing, research and time management;

  3. 1:1 and small group tutoring sessions;

  4. Guidance on relevant reference material;

  5. Assessment marking with long-form feedback

  6. Management of discussion forums; and

  7. Proactive, prompt and personalised support to student queries and issues.

LINC Fellows will be expected to promptly interact with students over email, or calls / online sessions from locations of their convenience (e.g. home, office etc.).

About LINC Education

LINC Education (), based in Singapore, with teams in Australia, India, the UK and the US, is a global pioneer in providing high-touch, high-quality educator-led online teaching services to globally ranked universities around the world. Our specialist services are highly sought after by university managements and faculty to retain and grow their online student enrolments. LINC’s services are customised for each university and delivered using a cutting-edge technology platform (LINCtrac) to provide a superior and effective learning experience to students. Since 2017, we have delivered online degrees on behalf of our partners to over 30,000 students across multiple disciplines with our 700+ globally located educators.

LINC is managed by education sector professionals with more than 50 years of combined experience and overseen by an advisory board of the best academic professionals in the world. Dr. Christopher Brook (Ex-Dean, Edith Cowan University and Curtin University), Dr. M Rammohan Rao (ex-Dean, Indian School of Business and ex-Director, IIM Bangalore) and Deepak Chandra (ex-Deputy Dean, Indian School of Business) are members of the LINC Board of Advisors.

In 2022,OES, Australia’s largest online education company, became one of our investors through which we joinedSEEK’s(SEK.AX) Education Portfolio

What’s on offer?

Selected applicants will be engaged as independent contractors and will be offered a competitive fixed remuneration of up to $6350 for a cohort of 25 students. Further upsides are available based on larger batch sizes as well as achievement-related increments of up to 20%.

Professional benefits include:

  • Working on behalf of globally ranked and recognised universities

  • Interacting with and learning from with high-quality university faculty;

  • Working with a diverse range of international students;

  • Specialized training for online teaching and delivery

  • Active mentoring for professional growth

  • Improving interpersonal and cross-cultural skills

The role ispart-time(15-20 hours per week) with scheduled weekend availability. Educators will have the flexibility to work from a location of their convenience.

Purpose The National Bankruptcy Processor is responsible for protecting the client’s interest by reviewing loans for possible legal action and taking all necessary actions to protect client’s interest without individual requests from the client. Specific Duties, Activities and Responsibilities

Motions for Relief: Specialist will prepare referrals for Motions for Relief and assist firm with any figures and documents required to proceed with the necessary legal action. Specialist will be required to review delinquent accounts and case disposition to determine appropriate action to take. Accounts must be audited and a ledger must be prepared to ensure all funds were received and applied correctly. Loan must be reviewed until the Motion is resolved. If a Stipulation is negotiated, specialist will be required to monitor compliance with the Stipulation and refer additional legal action as necessary. Impediments: Specialist must review loans immediately upon receipt for any items needed to proceed with account adjustments or legal action. Specialist will refer to jurisdictional requirements to confirm what items are required to proceed with required legal action. Frequent follow up and escalation for impediments is required until resolution. Specialist will have to be comfortable reviewing prior servicer histories and escrow analyses. Title Review: Specialist must be able to review mortgages, assignments, notes and allonges and determine any missing gaps in the chain of title. ECF Mail/AACER: Specialist will be required to review electronic mail from the court. All mail must be thoroughly reviewed and notated in firm’s system and client’s system. Specialist must be able to determine and proceed with any action needed in response to court mail received. Ensure local counsel has all necessary information to complete various notices and filings. Move all non-active files quickly through to closing. Review and interpret client systems and update data per client’s expectations. Regularly monitor reports that are generated in our system to ensure that files are handled smoothly and timely. Regularly monitor reports that are generated by the client’s system to ensure that files are handled smoothly and timely. Participate in company-sponsored educational seminars. Perform all other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

High School Diploma required, Bachelor Degree preferred Two or more years of experience in the bankruptcy and/or Mortgage Servicing arena. Proven track record of dependability and punctuality required. Usage of LPS is required; must be familiar with all Facets of LPS, including LPS Intercoms, LPS Reports, and LPS/ Client Directives. Must possess basic understanding of the fundamentals of Chapter 7, 11, and 13 Bankruptcies. Must be proficient with numbers and basic accounting. Must be proficient in software tools including but not limited to Word, Excel, Outlook and the Internet

General Competency Factors

Must be proficient in software tools, including but not limited to Word, Excel, Outlook, and the Internet. Must possess strong written and verbal communications skills. Must provide excellent customer service to internal and external customers Identifies and solves issues in a timely manner. Must be a team player and willing to help others in their department whenever necessary. Must be extremely organized and be able to multi-task. Conscientious with respect to work completion, deadlines, time management and attendance. Takes initiative in face of obstacles and identifies what needs to be done and takes action. Demonstrates commitment to Firm’s vision, mission, and core values. Analytical and detail oriented, while working at a fast pace and capable of multi-tasking. Develops professional relationships and builds rapport with others. Overall good work ethic and willingness to adapt to change.

raw.description:
General Manager – Scotch Whisky Projects & Business Development

Company: Whiskey Cask Group
Industry: Scotch Whisky | Independent Bottling | Private Label | Luxury Spirits
Location: UK or Dubai, UAE – Remote / Hybrid Working Available
Employment Type: Full-time or Consultancy (depending on experience)
Seniority: Senior Management
Remuneration: Competitive package based on experience, with performance-related incentives

About Whiskey Cask Group

Whiskey Cask Group is a specialist Scotch whisky business focused on developing exclusive whisky products and bespoke bottling programmes for private clients, corporate customers and international brands.

Our services include private-label Scotch whisky, limited-edition bottlings, corporate gifting, exclusive cask projects and premium whisky collections.

We work with established industry partners to manage everything from whisky sourcing and product development to bottling, packaging and international delivery.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced whisky industry professional to help manage our commercial activities, develop new business opportunities and oversee the successful delivery of client projects.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced General Manager – Scotch Whisky Projects & Business Development to play a key role in growing Whiskey Cask Group.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining business development, project management, supplier relationships and general business operations.

We are particularly interested in candidates who already have extensive experience within the Scotch whisky industry and an established network of contacts across distilleries, independent bottlers, cask suppliers and specialist production partners.

The successful candidate will be comfortable managing the complete lifecycle of a whisky project, from identifying a commercial opportunity and developing a proposal through to coordinating production and final delivery.

This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for someone with genuine whisky industry knowledge who can combine commercial thinking with practical project delivery and operational management.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Commercial Growth

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with private clients, corporate customers, luxury brands and international partners.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients and commercial projects.
  • Develop proposals, commercial pricing and project budgets.
  • Manage client relationships from initial enquiry through to contract negotiation and delivery.
  • Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, new products and international expansion.
  • Support the directors in developing and implementing the company's commercial strategy.

Whisky Sourcing & Industry Relationships

  • Maintain and develop relationships with Scotch whisky distilleries, independent bottlers, cask brokers and suppliers.
  • Source appropriate whisky stocks and bottling solutions for bespoke client projects.
  • Coordinate with bottling facilities, packaging suppliers, designers and logistics partners.
  • Negotiate pricing, production schedules and commercial agreements.
  • Identify reliable partners capable of delivering premium-quality whisky products.

Private Client & Bespoke Whisky Projects

  • Manage bespoke whisky projects from concept to completion.
  • Work directly with clients to understand their requirements, budgets and expectations.
  • Coordinate whisky selection, bottling, labelling, packaging and product presentation.
  • Oversee production schedules, supplier performance and quality control.
  • Manage project budgets, timelines and profitability.
  • Coordinate international fulfilment, export documentation and specialist delivery requirements.

General Management & Operations

  • Support the day-to-day commercial and operational management of Whiskey Cask Group.
  • Develop efficient processes for managing projects, suppliers and customers.
  • Monitor financial performance, project costs and commercial margins.
  • Manage multiple client projects and business development opportunities simultaneously.
  • Provide regular progress reports and commercial updates to the directors.
  • Help establish the systems, partnerships and operational infrastructure required to scale the business.

Essential Experience & Skills

Direct experience within the Scotch whisky industry is essential for this position.

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate:

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience within the Scotch whisky industry.
  • An established professional network within the bottling, distilling, whisky sourcing or independent bottling sectors.
  • Experience developing or managing private-label, bespoke bottling or exclusive whisky projects.
  • Strong commercial and business development capabilities.
  • Proven project management and supplier coordination experience.
  • Understanding of whisky production, sourcing, bottling, packaging and associated commercial costs.
  • Excellent client relationship management and negotiation skills.
  • Strong organisational and financial management capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and take ownership of business activities.

Desirable Experience

Additional experience in the following areas would be advantageous:

  • Independent Scotch whisky bottling businesses.
  • Private cask ownership and bespoke bottling programmes.
  • High-net-worth individuals and luxury private clients.
  • Corporate gifting and premium branded whisky programmes.
  • International whisky distribution and export.
  • Product development, packaging and brand creation.
  • Managing specialist bottling and international fulfilment partners.
  • Experience growing or managing a small or medium-sized whisky business.

Location & Flexible Working

We recognise that experienced whisky industry professionals may be based in different locations.

This role offers flexibility, including the opportunity to work remotely from Dubai, UAE, or the United Kingdom.

We are open to discussing remote, hybrid or consultancy arrangements with the right candidate.

The position will require regular communication with our international clients and industry partners, with occasional travel to suppliers, bottling facilities and client meetings where necessary.

Our priority is finding the right person with the industry experience, commercial capabilities and professional network to help develop the business.

What We Offer

  • A senior role within a growing specialist Scotch whisky business.
  • The opportunity to take ownership of commercial growth and client projects.
  • Direct involvement in the company's business strategy and international expansion.
  • Access to exciting bespoke whisky projects for private and corporate clients.
  • Flexible working arrangements, including remote working from Dubai.
  • Significant autonomy and the opportunity to shape the future development of the business.
  • Competitive remuneration with potential performance-related incentives.

Who We're Looking For

You may currently be working for an independent bottler, whisky merchant, cask company, distillery or specialist spirits business.

Perhaps you have spent years developing relationships within the whisky industry and are now looking for an opportunity to use that experience in a more entrepreneurial environment.

We are looking for someone who understands the industry, knows the right people and can confidently take a whisky project from initial discussion to finished product.

Someone who can develop business, manage suppliers, coordinate projects and help us build a successful international whisky company.

Industry knowledge, established relationships and practical experience are far more important to us than formal qualifications.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV along with a short introduction explaining your experience within the Scotch whisky industry.

We would particularly welcome examples of private bottling projects, supplier relationships, commercial partnerships or bespoke whisky programmes you have successfully managed.

We look forward to hearing from experienced whisky professionals who would like to play an important role in the next stage of Whiskey Cask Group's growth.

raw.excerpt: About KinaxisAre you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career?
raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Ireland.

About the team

The IT Support Technician provides the first point of contact between internal staff and the Corporate IT department. This role is responsible for delivering comprehensive remote support across EMEA and other global locations. The position serves as the initial point of contact for employees seeking technical assistance and provides first-level support through telephone, virtual and online channels, both for software and hardware needs. Additionally, collaboration with other members of the Corporate IT team is essential to ensure prompt and effective resolution of IT-related inquiries for a global workforce.

What you will do

  • Understand specific challenges and desired outcomes of end-users through communication and software/hardware assessment, providing technical support, guidance, and solutions to resolve IT-related issues following pre-established SLAs and ticket handling procedures.
  • Lead technical analysis on assigned tickets, typically of a routine nature, communicating updates and solutions through the ticketing system, ensuring both teammates and end-users are kept informed regarding the status of requests.
  • Perform Onboarding & Offboarding processes, including new hire account creation, hardware provisioning, account decommissioning, and repurposing assets from former employees.
  • Install, diagnose, repair, maintain, and upgrade hardware, software and IT equipment to support Kinaxis end users and business operations.
  • Conduct tests and root cause analyses on systems and hardware to ensure functionality and to deliver appropriate solutions related to products and systems.
  • Participate in testing new systems, services, processes and document findings.
  • Ship hardware/laptops to newly hired employees and replacements to existing staff members across EMEA and other regions as required. Liaise with the internal teams, logistics partners, vendors, and suppliers to manage logistics for timely delivery.
  • Liaise with local/global vendors and suppliers
  • Support and manage company phone devices predominantly within EMEA while supporting other regions as required. Support the ordering and setup of devices as per company standards and liaise with phone carrier vendors, as and when required
  • Interpret data and analyze results with the intention of sharing information related to IT Service tickets, and suggest opportunities to reduce ticket volume and enhance service
  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of documentation & Knowledge Base articles regarding IT processes, systems, and issues, with the intention of promoting self-service.
  • Participating in the weekend On-Call L1 support rota and respond outside of business hours where necessary
  • Respond to P1 calls during regular business hours on weekdays as required
  • Deliver end-user training on IT Services where necessary
  • International travel, including travel within EMEA may be required on an ad hoc basis to support the business, a valid passport is required.
  • Other duties as required

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 3-5 years of IT Service Desk experience providing remote end-user support across multiple locations.
  • Post-secondary education (degree or diploma) in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • ITIL, A+, Network+, and/or MCSA certifications are considered an asset.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply sound judgment in resolving technical and operational challenges.
  • Strong customer service skills with experience assessing end-user requests, delivering effective solutions, and communicating technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to build rapport and collaborate effectively with fellow technicians and end-users.
  • Strong experience working with ticketing and self-service platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Strong experience supporting enterprise technologies, including Windows and Mac OS, Active Directory, BitLocker, VPN, Okta, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, RDP, cloud solutions, Intune MDM, and OS patch management; experience with Exchange Online is an asset.
  • Basic networking and infrastructure knowledge is considered an asset.
  • Understanding of ITSM, incident and request management processes, onboarding and offboarding procedures, and cybersecurity and privacy best practices.
  • Basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts and tools, with the ability to identify opportunities to improve productivity, troubleshooting, and user support.
  • Proven ability to prioritize and reprioritize work, manage multiple tickets under tight deadlines, and adapt quickly to changing business needs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate professionally and build strong working relationships.

#ntryLevel, #Fresher, #Associate

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at . This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

raw.description:
Detta är en fjärrposition.

Vi på Secify är ett passionerat gäng med en stenhård tro på att tillvaron kan bli säkrare - och vi som jobbar här vill vara med och hjälpa till. Vi söker nu fler duktiga personer till vårt konsultteam!

Din roll på Secify

Som rådgivare/konsult kommer du arbeta i våra uppdrag hos kund, men utgå från Secifys kontor. Beroende på uppdrag kommer du antingen att arbeta självständigt, eller i en projektgrupp tillsammans med dina kollegor. Som rådgivare kommer du bland annat att arbeta som extern DPO, arbeta med dataskyddsanalyser och implementering av ledningssystem för dataskydd och informationssäkerhet, ta fram och implementera dataskyddsstrategier, och i stort rådge våra kunder i deras dataskydds & informationssäkerhetsbekymmer.

Du kommer också att vara med och anpassa och paketera tjänster och lösningar till våra kunder, och utveckla Secify framåt.

Ansvarsområden

  • Leda och genomföra uppdrag hos våra kunder.
  • Utveckla kunder & samarbetspartners.
  • Utveckla tjänster och koncept tillsammans med teamet.

Krav

Din profil och kvalifikationer

  • Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning två år eller längre.
  • Du har arbetat med dataskydd eller informationssäkerhet i minst 1 år
  • Du har god kunskap i GDPR
  • Du har god kunskap inom riskhantering.
  • Du har god förmåga att instruera och förklara dataskyddsarbetets betydelse och fördelar för kunder inom olika branscher, organisationer och för olika befattningar.
  • Du är nyfiken på att skapa nya kontakter och utveckla affärer.
  • Har du arbetat som konsult tidigare är det meriterande.
  • Har du erfarenhet av att arbeta med ISO27000-serien är det meriterande.
  • Du har flytande kunskap i både svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift.

För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du är ödmjuk, självgående, serviceminded och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs i en varierande miljö och kan hantera flera arbetsuppgifter samtidigt. Du är också förtroendeingivande och gillar att jobba ut mot kunder. Du gillar när det händer saker och driver på! Du drivs av att utveckla affärer med kunder samtidigt som du hjälper dina kollegor att göra detsamma. Vi tror också att du har ett genuint intresse för området och vill vara med i arbetet att göra världen till en säkrare plats.

Vi söker dig som tycker det är viktigt att tillhöra ett team som umgås, har roligt ihop, hjälper varandra och väljer varandra långsiktigt.


Fördelar

Beskrivning av Secify

Secify är ett renodlat informations- och cybersäkerhetsbolag.

Bland andra bolag i vår nisch har vi gjort det till vår mission att göra cyber- och informationssäkerhet så roligt och enkelt som det går. Vi vill göra det med ödmjukhet och respekt för kunden genom att tänka affärsorienterat och förstå kundens verksamhet. Vi tror på ett pragmatiskt och okomplicerat förhållningsätt till informationssäkerhet. No nonsense Security!

Vi är ett ungt företag som på lite mer än 8 år har gjort en enormt spännande resa, och vi har en tydlig vision om hur vi ska fortsätta växa.

Vi som jobbar här har en väldigt blandad bakgrund, men två saker enar oss; passionen att göra tillvaron till en säkrare, och ambitionen att ha kul under arbetets gång. Våra medarbetare besitter tillsammans en bred, och var för sig vass, kompetens. Vi är alla en viktig del av byggandet av Secify, och vi erbjuder dig chansen att bli nästa pusselbit.

Vi erbjuder dig

  • Garanterat kul på jobbet
  • Möjligheten att gå hem mitt på dagen för att vattna kaktusen eller gå med hunden (d.v.s. flexibla arbetstider)
  • Möjligheten att jobba på kontoret, hemifrån, eller från sommarstugan (d.v.s. flexibel arbetsplats)
  • Stora möjligheter att påverka Secifys riktning framåt
  • Möjligheten att jobba i ett nischat företag i en spännande bransch
  • En plats i ett team som tar hand om varandra på riktigt, känner passion över sitt arbete, och ser alla som pusselbitar i framgången
  • Möjligheten att jobba med riktigt intressanta tjänster och göra spännande affärer
  • Varma och visionära ledare som vill se dig växa och må bra
  • Möjlighet till delägarskap
  • En arbetsplats med bra villkor, vi är kollektivanslutna och erbjuder såklart tjänstepension och andra hygienfaktorer så som sjukförsäkring, friskvårdsbidrag etc
  • Att jobba på Secify är utvecklande och väldigt roligt. Du får se många olika verksamheter och skapar många värdefulla kontakter. Du får jobba med många och nya utmaningar, den personliga utvecklingen är väldigt stor. Du har ett väldigt stort eget ansvar samtidigt som du har extremt stor frihet.
  • Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter
  • Roliga och givande resor och konferenser.

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner Part Time - Kirksville

Job Location: Work at Home, Missouri, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part-time Nurse Practitioner to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:
  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes
  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs
  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role
  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed
  • Conduct virtual visits as needed
  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Part-time employees qualify for:
  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)
  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)
  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications
  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)
  • Board certification (required)
  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

29.5

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$37.66 - $81.11

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

raw.description:
Job Title: Key Account Manager – Infectious Disease I Region Augsburg, München, Allgäu

Job Location: Germany - Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Über Abbott

Abbott ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen, das bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse nutzt und Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Gesundheit der Menschen entwickelt. Wir blicken stets in die Zukunft und antizipieren Veränderungen in der medizinischen Wissenschaft und Technologie.

In Deutschland ist Abbott mit mehr als 4.000 Mitarbeiter:innen in den Bereichen Forschung und Entwicklung, Logistik, Produktion und Vertrieb vertreten. Neben dem deutschen Hauptsitz in Wiesbaden hat Abbott Standorte in Hannover, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Wetzlar, Eschborn, Jena, Köln und Hamburg.

 

Die Position

Die Position wird an unserem Standort Köln (Abbott Rapid Diagnostics Germany GmbH) im Bereich Infectious Disease angegliedert und für die Region Augsburg, München, Allgäuverantwortlich sein.

In der Rolle des Key Account Managers – Infectious Diseases (m/w/d) verantworten Sie den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung strategischer Key Accounts im Bereich Secondary Care und treiben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Geschäftsbereichen die nationale Umsetzung von Produkt‑ und Service­strategien von Abbott voran.

Unser Point-of-Care-Diagnoseportfolio umfasst wichtige Gesundheits- und Therapiebereiche, darunter Infektionskrankheiten, Kardiometabolische Erkrankungen und Toxikologie.

Unsere diagnostischen Lösungen werden in Krankenhäusern, Laboren und Kliniken rund um den Globus eingesetzt. Die entscheidenden Informationen, die aus unseren Tests und Instrumenten gewonnen werden, sind oft der erste Schritt bei der Entscheidungsfindung in der Patientenversorgung für Hunderte von Gesundheitszuständen, von Herzinfarkten über Blutkrankheiten bis hin zu Infektionskrankheiten.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Strategische Entwicklung von Märkten und Key Accounts im Bereich Secondary Care zur nachhaltigen Erreichung der Verkaufsziele für das ARDx‑Produktportfolio
  • Steuerung, Umsetzung und Kontinuitätskontrolle von Verkaufsstrategien auf Basis relevanter KPIs, Kundenbedürfnisse und definierter Produkt‑ und Marktkonzepte
  • Eigenverantwortliche Verhandlung und Vertragsgestaltung mit Entscheidungsträgern auf C‑Level in Krankenhausketten sowie Einkaufs‑ und Beschaffungsorganisationen
  • Identifikation, Analyse und adressatengerechte Darstellung von Kundenherausforderungen und Geschäftspotenzialen, mit dem Ziel langfristige, strategische Partnerschaften von nationaler Bedeutung aufzubauen und abzusichern
  • Sicherstellung eines exzellenten Kundenservices sowie aktive Unterstützung von Veränderungs‑ und Implementierungsinitiativen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten internen und externen Stakeholdern
  • Konzeptionelle und strategische Umsetzung von Produkteinführungen sowie Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung zielgerichteter Marketing‑ und Vertriebsinitiativen für ARDx‑Produkte
  • Professionelle Repräsentation von Abbott und dem Produktportfolio bei Vertriebs‑ und Marketingmeetings, Fachveranstaltungen, Kongressen und Konferenzen

Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Naturwissenschaften oder vergleichbar; alternativ eine medizinische Ausbildung oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Diagnostik oder Medizintechnik
  • Relevante Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb der Medizintechnik, Diagnostik oder einem vergleichbaren, regulierten Umfeld – idealerweise mit strategischem Kundenfokus
  • Fundiertes Verständnis des Secondary‑Care‑Marktes, einschließlich relevanter Marktstrukturen, Entscheidungsprozesse sowie wichtiger Schlüsselkunden und Einkaufsorganisationen
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung im Auf‑ und Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen auf Management‑ und Entscheider-Ebene
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations‑ und Verhandlungsstärke sowie souveränes Auftreten in komplexen, nationalen Verhandlungs‑ und Entscheidungsprozessen
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und resiliente Arbeitsweise auch in dynamischen Marktsituationen
  • Hohe Problemlösungskompetenz, Kundenorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und überzeugend zu vermitteln
  • Ausgeprägte Team‑ und Stakeholder‑Orientierung, verbunden mit einem hohen Maß an Eigeninitiative, Energie und Gestaltungswillen
  • Sehr gute Organisations‑, Moderations‑ und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, auch in nationalen Gremien oder bereichsübergreifenden Projekten
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint zur Analyse, Aufbereitung und Präsentation vertrieblicher und strategischer Inhalte
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft (ca. 70–80 %) innerhalb des Vertriebsgebiets
  • Fließende Deutsch‑ und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann bewerben Sie sich bei uns.  

Wir freuen uns auf Sie! 

Arbeiten bei Abbott

Bei Abbott finden Sie eine Aufgabe, die wirklich zählt, denn Sie verhelfen anderen Menschen zu einem gesünderen und erfüllten Leben. Wachsen Sie mit uns und lernen Sie stetig dazu – Sie können hier Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung vorantreiben und sich selbst verwirklichen.

Das erwartet Sie bei uns:

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem internationalen Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Karriere machen können, von der Sie träumen
  • Ein attraktives Benefit-Paket (z.B. Company Bike, Mitarbeiteraktienkaufprogramm)
  • Eine herausfordernde Position in einer schnell wachsenden krisenunabhängigen Branche
  • Die Möglichkeit, Teil eines dynamischen, hochqualifizierten und motivierten Teams zu werden
  • Flache Hierarchien, offene, wertschätzende Mentalität und effiziente, konstruktive Kommunikationswege
  • Ein multinationales Umfeld, in dem wir die Entwicklung unserer Talente innerhalb des Unternehmens fördern
  • Ein Unternehmen, das als eine der “Best Big Companies To Work For“ anerkannt ist, sowie als bester Platz zum Arbeiten für Vielfalt, arbeitende Mütter, weibliche Führungskräfte und Wissenschaftler:innen

Folgen Sie Ihren Karrierezielen bei Abbott für vielfältige Möglichkeiten mit einem Unternehmen, das Ihnen helfen kann, Ihre Zukunft aufzubauen und Ihr bestes Leben zu führen. Abbott ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit, der sich der Vielfalt der Mitarbeiter verschrieben hat.

Schwerbehinderte Bewerber:innen werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt. 

 

Wir bitten um Ihr Verständnis, dass wir ausschließlich Online-Bewerbungen über unser Online-Bewerbungsportal berücksichtigen. Bewerbungen per E-Mail oder per Post können nicht verarbeitet werden. Originalunterlagen werden nicht zurückgeschickt.

The Vice President, Quality & Accreditation is the enterprise executive accountable for clinical quality performance across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial. This role owns HEDIS strategy and operations, accreditation (NCQA, URAC, and applicable state/federal standards), clinical quality programs, and the vendor ecosystem that supports HEDIS data collection, abstraction, and reporting.

This executive unifies quality functions historically siloed by line of business into a single operating model, ensuring consistent measurement, documentation, and improvement practices across Medicare and Commercial populations.

The role is accountable for HEDIS rates and audit results, accreditation status and survey outcomes, clinical quality program performance, and vendor ecosystem governance and cost.

Key Responsibilities:
Enterprise Quality Leadership & Operating Model
• Build a unified quality operating model across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial.
• Establish enterprise governance for clinical documentation integrity supporting quality measurement.
• Serve as the executive owner of enterprise HEDIS performance and accreditation status.
• Oversee all HEDIS operations, hybrid strategy, supplemental data, and provider documentation improvement, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Develop best-in-class intervention playbooks for each HEDIS measure.

Clinical Quality

  • Lead enterprise clinical quality programs, including quality improvement initiatives, clinical practice guideline adoption, and provider quality performance programs.
    • Ensure alignment with care management and population health functions on shared clinical priorities.

Job Description

Who We Are

Horizon Media, founded in 1989 by Bill Koenigsberg, is recognized as one of the most innovative marketing and advertising firms. Headquartered in New York City, with offices in Los Angeles and Toronto, Horizon is known for its data-driven approach, highly personal client service, and people-first culture. We hire talented thinkers, doers, dreamers, and makers, challenge them, and give them opportunities to grow.


Job Summary

The Application Support Specialist, Canada Media Applications is a temporary role providing hands-on Level 1 and Level 2 support as Horizon Canada transitions to and stabilizes within a Horizon-managed Mediaocean environment. Reporting to the VP, Business Operations, this role will support the Canadian business from implementation and cutover through production stabilization and ongoing operations.

The role will partner across Canada Media Operations, Finance, Business Operations, Shared Services, Financial Systems, Technology, Security, and external providers. The successful candidate will combine application-support discipline with practical knowledge of media planning, buying, billing, reconciliation, master data, access, reporting, and integrations.


What You'll Do

Day-to-Day Application Support & Service Management

  • Primary Support: Serve as the primary application support resource and day-to-day liaison for Horizon Canada across Mediaocean Prisma, Spectra Digital, Spectra Linear, OX, and other supported media applications.
  • Incident, Request & Queue Management: Manage Level 1 and Level 2 incidents, service requests, problems, and escalations in ServiceNow from intake through closure, including prioritization, documentation, ownership, user updates, and SLA adherence.
  • Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot campaign setup, workflow, configuration, billing, reconciliation, master data, reporting, integration, authentication, and user-access issues; document findings and coordinate escalation when needed.
  • Vendor Coordination: Coordinate resolution with Mediaocean, internal application owners, Technology teams, Edenred / IPS, and other vendors or partners.
  • Problem Management: Identify recurring incidents and root causes, document support risks, and coordinate preventive or corrective action.

Canada Implementation, Conversion & Stabilization Support

  • Implementation Readiness: Participate in implementation and transition working sessions and translate Canadian operational needs into executable setup, configuration, data, access, testing, and support activities.
  • Master Data Readiness: Support the review, validation, cleanup, preparation, and controlled loading of users, clients, products, suppliers, vendors, remit and pay-to relationships, stations, publications, security roles, and other required master data.
  • Testing & Validation: Develop and execute test scenarios and support integration testing, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, retesting, and business validation across planning, buying, billing, reconciliation, reporting, and downstream interfaces.
  • Integration Support: Monitor and help troubleshoot application and data-flow issues across Mediaocean, integrations, NetSuite interfaces, Edenred / IPS workflows, and related reporting or financial processes; route functional and technical issues to the correct owner.
  • Cutover & Hypercare: Support cutover planning, production readiness, go-live, hypercare, issue triage, production validation, and stabilization until the Canadian environment is operating reliably.

Application Administration, Access & Controls

  • User Administration: Provision, modify, and deprovision approved users, roles, permissions, user groups, security profiles, and licenses across supported applications.
  • Access Governance: Support periodic access reviews, licensing audits, segregation-of-duties reviews, evidence collection, and remediation of access inconsistencies.
  • Configuration Support: Maintain approved application settings and configuration documentation and coordinate controlled changes with application owners and vendors.
  • Operational Controls: Follow established change and production support controls and maintain complete audit trails for support, configuration, and access activities.

Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Knowledge Management: Maintain SOPs, support procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guidance, user instructions, known-error documentation, and escalation paths.
  • Support Reporting: Maintain reporting on ticket volume, aging, SLA performance, escalations, recurring issues, and application health.
  • Release Support: Participate in releases, upgrades, patches, configuration changes, maintenance activities, and post-release production validation.
  • Continuous Improvement: Recommend improvements to service quality, data integrity, operational efficiency, user experience, and production stability.

Who You Are

  • Hands-On and Accountable: You are comfortable working directly in applications, managing tickets, following issues through resolution, and maintaining ownership of commitments.
  • Experienced in Media Operations: You understand how media planning, buying, billing, reconciliation, master data, reporting, and downstream financial processes connect.
  • A Practical Problem Solver: You can distinguish between user, process, data, configuration, integration, and system-defect issues and route work appropriately.
  • Service-Oriented: You provide clear, responsive support and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.
  • A Strong Cross-Functional Partner: You collaborate effectively across Media Operations, Finance, Business Operations, Shared Services, Technology, Security, Financial Systems, and external vendors.
  • Organized and Detail-Oriented: You can manage competing priorities while maintaining accurate documentation, controls, status updates, and follow-through.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant application support experience, preferably within an advertising agency, media organization, or comparable enterprise environment.
  • Direct hands-on experience supporting Mediaocean Prisma and Mediaocean Spectra Digital and Linear.
  • Experience providing Level 1 and Level 2 production support and managing incidents, service requests, problems, and escalations through ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise platform.
  • Experience supporting media planning, buying, billing, reconciliation, master data, reporting, application access, and operational workflows.
  • Experience supporting implementations, data conversions, integrations, UAT, regression testing, cutover, releases, migrations, or post-go-live stabilization.
  • Working knowledge of role-based access, user provisioning, access reviews, application controls, and audit-support practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, stakeholder-management, and customer-service skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating with teams across New York, Toronto, and other North American locations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Canadian media operations and business processes.
  • Experience with Canadian-dollar or multi-currency media and financial workflows.
  • Familiarity with GST, HST, PST, and QST processing requirements and related master-data or reporting considerations.
  • Exposure to Mediaocean-to-ERP integrations, enterprise integration platforms NetSuite interfaces, or invoice-processing platforms such as Edenred / IPS.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL-based incident, problem, change, release, and knowledge-management practices.

Supervisory & Organizational Details

  • Supervisory Responsibilities: None.
  • Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations: None required.
  • Work Environment: This is a temporary, remote position based in New York. The role will collaborate closely with stakeholders in Toronto and teams across North America. Periodic travel or extended hours may be required during testing, cutover, go-live, releases, maintenance, month-end support, and critical issue resolution.

raw.description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

Practice Overview:

Ankura’s Health Care team is a recognized leader in health care and life sciences disputes, compliance, and investigations. The team combines clinical, technical, operational, financial, economic, and analytic expertise to help clients and counsel resolve complex matters involving payers, providers, pharmacies, and law firms.

This role is specifically focused on expanding Ankura’s payer/provider disputes platform: matters where commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, exchange, and other health plan arrangements require rigorous data analytics and defensible damages analysis.

Role Overview:

The Senior Managing Director will be an executive-level, self-sustaining rainmaker who originates, sells, leads, and testifies in complex healthcare commercial disputes. The role requires a credible marketplace presence with health plans, law firms, and healthcare-focused private equity or strategic stakeholders.

  • Primary focus: payer/provider contract, payment, reimbursement, claims, coding, utilization, medical policy, network, and financial disputes.

  • Core technical differentiator: ability to direct large-scale data analytics teams and translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, supportable damages opinions.

  • Expected revenue impact: proven, tangible business development record with the ability to produce at least $3M in revenue and a target opportunity to generate $3M to $5M+ annually.

  • Expert role: serve as a consulting expert or testifying expert, including report development, deposition preparation, arbitration or trial testimony, and expert rebuttal work.

Target Candidate Profile:

  • Market position: Recognized rainmaker in healthcare disputes with established relationships among payer/provider counsel, managed care executives, provider finance leaders, and litigation decision-makers.

  • Dispute focus: Deep experience in payer/provider commercial disputes, including underpayment, overpayment, contract interpretation, rate methodology, coding, claim adjudication, stop-loss, risk adjustment, value-based care, network adequacy, medical necessity, utilization, denial, recoupment, and reimbursement disputes.

  • Data analytics leadership: Can lead multidisciplinary teams analyzing large claims, eligibility, encounter, remittance, contract, provider, authorization, utilization, coding, clinical, and financial datasets using scalable, quality-controlled analytics.

  • Damages expertise: Can develop defensible models for lost revenue, underpayment, overpayment, offsets, recoupments, interest, damages scenarios, counterfactuals, and sensitivity analyses.

  • Expert witness credibility: Has authored expert reports and provided deposition, arbitration, trial, or hearing testimony in healthcare disputes.

Responsibilities:

Business Development and Market Leadership

  • Originate and expand relationships with national and regional law firms, health plans, pharmacy organizations, and healthcare investors that routinely face payer/provider reimbursement and damages disputes.

  • Develop a go-to-market plan focused on payer/provider disputes where Ankura can combine healthcare industry expertise, advanced analytics, damages modeling, and expert testimony.

  • Build a visible marketplace presence through panels, publications, law firm briefings, client training, and industry events focused on managed care litigation, reimbursement disputes, and claims analytics.

  • Convert marketplace relationships into consulting expert, testifying expert, privileged advisory, and complex analytics engagements.

Technical and Disputes Expertise

  • Lead matters involving contract breaches, payment disputes, underpayment or overpayment claims, reimbursement methodology, fee schedules, DRG/APC/APG or other payment logic, risk corridors, value-based payment, capitation, shared savings, risk adjustment, denials, recoupments, and claims adjudication issues.

  • Apply knowledge of commercial, Medicare Advantage, Part D, Medicaid managed care, ACA exchange, pharmacy, and provider reimbursement operations when developing case strategy and damages approaches.

  • Assess liability and damages theories in collaboration with counsel while preserving attorney-client privilege, work-product protection, and expert independence where applicable.

  • Prepare expert reports, rebuttal reports, declarations, deposition testimony, arbitration testimony, trial testimony, and demonstratives that explain complex analytics in plain English.

Large-Scale Data Analytics and Damages

  • Direct data teams analyzing high-volume healthcare datasets, including claims, encounters, eligibility, premium, membership, remittance, EOB/EOP, authorization, denial, utilization, coding, provider contract, fee schedule, capitation, risk adjustment, and financial data.

  • Design repeatable analytic workplans that include data intake, normalization, validation, completeness testing, reconciliation, exception handling, sampling or extrapolation where appropriate, quality control, and audit trails.

  • Develop damages models that quantify alleged underpayments, overpayments, lost revenue, leakage, offsets, recoupment exposure, reasonable value, contract-based damages, and alternative damages scenarios.

  • Translate analytic findings into counsel-ready narratives, executive presentations, settlement support, mediation materials, expert reports, and trial or arbitration demonstratives.

  • Partner with data scientists, statisticians, coding experts, clinicians, economists, forensic accountants, and operations professionals to ensure analytic conclusions are technically sound and legally defensible.

Client Delivery and Team Leadership

  • Serve as the accountable executive on complex, multi-workstream matters with law firm, payer, provider, and board-level stakeholders.

  • Scope and price engagements, staff teams, manage budgets, review work product, ensure quality, and deliver concise insights under litigation deadlines.

  • Mentor directors, managing directors, analytics professionals, clinicians, coders, and operational specialists, with a focus on developing future testifying experts and client-facing leaders.

  • Collaborate across Ankura practices, including Health Economics, Data Analytics including AI, Strategy and Performance, Forensic Accounting, Investigations, and other dispute capabilities.

Relevant Matter Experience

  • Payer/provider contract disputes involving alleged underpayment, denial, repricing, reimbursement methodology, rate implementation, or recoupment issues.

  • Managed care disputes involving Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, ACA exchange, commercial group, self-funded, pharmacy, or delegated-risk arrangements.

  • Large-scale claims and encounter analytics supporting affirmative damages, rebuttal damages, settlement valuation, mediation, arbitration, or trial.

  • Hospital, physician, ancillary, pharmacy, behavioral health, and specialty provider reimbursement disputes.

  • Matters requiring expert reports, rebuttal analyses, deposition testimony, arbitration testimony, or trial testimony.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in business, finance, accounting, economics, data analytics, health care operations, health policy, clinical discipline, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • 10+ years of litigation, disputes, forensic, damages, payer/provider reimbursement, managed care, healthcare analytics, or consulting experience; senior consulting leadership experience strongly preferred.

  • Proven and tangible business development record with a portable book of relationships and revenue generation of at least $3M; demonstrated ability to grow toward $3M to $5M+ annually.

  • Specific experience originating and leading payer/provider commercial disputes, reimbursement disputes, managed care litigation, claims analytics, damages quantification, or expert witness engagements.

  • Demonstrated ability to direct large project teams analyzing complex healthcare datasets and producing quality-controlled analytic outputs for counsel, executives, and triers of fact.

  • Experience authoring expert reports, rebuttal reports, declarations, affidavits, or damages analyses; prior deposition, arbitration, trial, or hearing testimony strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare legal, regulatory, reimbursement, and operational issues affecting payers, providers, pharmacies, and government program participants.

  • Exceptional executive communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical, analytic, reimbursement, and damages issues to boards, C-suite clients, law firms, regulators, mediators, arbitrators, judges, and juries.

  • Demonstrated commitment to privilege, confidentiality, work-product discipline, expert independence, collaboration, quality, and team development.

  • Ability and willingness to travel; must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Epilepsy Foundation is seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Senior Manager of Contracts and Procurement with deep experience in government grant compliance, contract negotiation, procurement, and regulatory reporting within the nonprofit sector.

This role is responsible for overseeing the organization’s contracts and procurement functions while ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local requirements, including the Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA), Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), and applicable state charitable registration requirements.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience navigating complex regulatory requirements, managing high-stakes contracts and agreements, and partnering across departments to mitigate organizational risk and ensure compliance. This position will serve as a key subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting, and regulatory obligations while supporting the Foundation’s mission and organizational priorities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Contracts & Procurement Management: Execute and oversee the end-to-end contracts and procurement function, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance for federally and state-funded grants.
  • Federal Grant Compliance: Ensure organizational adherence to federal grant requirements, including FFATA reporting, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), cost principles, procurement standards, and other applicable requirements.
  • Contract Development & Negotiation: Lead the review, drafting, negotiation, and administration of contracts, memoranda of understanding (MOUs), subrecipient agreements, cooperative agreements, and vendor contracts.
  • Charitable Registration Compliance: Coordinate state charitable solicitation registrations, renewals, and related compliance requirements across applicable jurisdictions.
  • Policies & Procedures: Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve procurement and contracting policies and procedures that align with nonprofit best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Grant & Funder Requirements: Monitor and report on compliance with funder-specific procurement requirements, contractual obligations, and reporting requirements.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Programs, Development, and other internal stakeholders to align procurement and contracting activities with organizational goals, grant requirements, and deliverables.
  • Vendor & Subcontractor Management: Manage supplier, vendor, subcontractor, and subrecipient due diligence, contractual obligations, compliance requirements, and performance.
  • Audit Support: Play an integral role in organizational audits, including the annual Uniform Guidance Audit, by ensuring appropriate procurement and contracting documentation and compliance.
  • Training & Guidance: Develop and provide training and guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement compliance, contracting procedures, ethics, and federal and state funding requirements.
  • Risk Management: Identify and mitigate contractual, procurement, and compliance risks while ensuring appropriate documentation and internal controls.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen contracting and procurement processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance organizational compliance.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Public Administration, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required; JD or master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in contract management and procurement, including at least 5 years supporting federal and state grant compliance within a nonprofit, government, or government-funded environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of FFATA, 2 CFR Part 200 (Uniform Guidance), federal procurement requirements, cost principles, and state charitable registration requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex grant-related contracts, subrecipient agreements, cooperative agreements, subcontracts, and vendor relationships.
  • Strong contract drafting, review, negotiation, and risk assessment skills.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of procurement regulations, internal controls, audit readiness, and compliance requirements applicable to nonprofits and federal grantees.
  • Experience supporting organizational audits, including Uniform Guidance Audits.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Ability to interpret complex regulatory and contractual requirements and communicate them clearly to internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Legal, Finance, Programs, Development, and other organizational functions.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex priorities and deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, discretion, and ethical decision-making.
  • Proficiency with contract, grant, financial, and organizational management systems; experience with Salesforce and Sage Intacct preferred.

Key Competencies:

  • Regulatory & Compliance Expertise
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation
  • Federal & State Grant Compliance
  • Nonprofit Legal & Regulatory Acumen
  • Procurement & Vendor Management
  • Risk Assessment & Mitigation
  • Attention to Detail
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Strategic Thinking & Process Improvement
  • Ethical & Transparent Decision-Making

Travel & Work Requirements:

  • This is a remote position with travel required approximately 4–6 times annually for organizational meetings, conferences, audits, trainings, or other business-related activities.
  • Must be able to work effectively and collaboratively in a remote work environment.
  • Occasional flexibility outside of standard business hours may be required to support audits, reporting deadlines, contract negotiations, or other time-sensitive organizational needs.

raw.description:
ChildFund Australia is a member of the ChildFund Alliance – a global network of 10 organisations which assists almost 36 million children and their families in 66 countries. ChildFund Australia directly manages and implements programs with a range of local partners in Cambodia, Myanmar, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste, Vietnam, and other Pacific nations, and manages projects delivered by partner organisations throughout Asia, Africa, and the Americas.

Purpose

ChildFund seeks to strengthen its existing participation approach so that stakeholders can engage with, validate, challenge, and enrich the findings of Child Rights Situation Analyses, helping to identify priority issues, emerging trends, evidence gaps, and opportunities for action. The resulting insights will inform organisational strategy, country planning, program portfolios, advocacy priorities, and investment decisions, ensuring that these are grounded not only in published evidence but also in the perspectives and experiences of children and communities themselves.

This assignment will develop practical guidelines, tools, and supporting resources that enable this process to be undertaken consistently across country contexts. The approach should be low burden, repeatable, and designed to leverage existing community engagement structures wherever possible, recognising the capacity constraints facing Country Offices and partners. It should also promote accountability by establishing clear mechanisms for reporting back on how participant feedback influenced findings, priorities, and subsequent decisions.

The consultant will also provide technical advice on the role of Youth Voice in ChildFund’s strategy development and broader strategic decision-making, including its evolving purpose, Terms of Reference, engagement processes and feedback mechanisms.

The consultancy period is 20 days spread across 3 months.

Interested consultants should submit an expression of interest including: a technical proposal (max. 3 pages) outlining understanding of the assignment, proposed search strategy and sources, and workplan; a financial proposal/fee schedule in USD; a curriculum vitae including at least two references from similar assignments; and a sample of previous, similar written work.

ChildFund Australia believes in a global community where children are safe and can reach their full potential. We take extensive steps to safeguard children in any work done by our people, i.e., our staff, volunteers and interns, supporters, partners, board members, ambassadors and suppliers. We strive to keep children safe through child safe practices, and rigorously ensure we prevent, oppose, and combat all exploitation and abuse of children and vulnerable people. As part of this commitment, all people working with us will undergo relevant background checks before joining ChildFund Australia.

At ChildFund Australia, all staff must remain alert and responsive to any child safeguarding or sexual exploitation, abuse, or harassment (SEAH) risks. Staff will acquire the knowledge and skills needed to understand our Child Safeguarding and PSEAH policies & procedures, promote strong safeguarding practices, and conduct themselves consistent with these policies.

In line with our values, diversity of people and ideas is critical to our work and our success at ChildFund Australia. We strive for a team culture that is welcoming, inclusive, and supportive. ChildFund is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and strongly encourages people from all backgrounds, abilities, and identities to apply
