The Pharmacy Access Manager supports Patient Services programs by strategically navigating the patient access process from prescription intake through treatment initiation. This role combines patient access and reimbursement expertise with a pharmacy technician background and to identify and address barriers related to coverage, authorization, prescription processing, pharmacy coordination, affordability, and fulfillment.

Candidates must hold an active Pharmacy Technician license in their state of residence

AND

Be willing and able to obtain aTexas Pharmacy Technician license

The Pharmacy Access Manager serves as a central point of coordination among patients, healthcare providers and their office staff, payors, specialty pharmacy, dispensing and non-dispensing pharmacies, client stakeholders, and internal PRO-spectus teams. The role provides guidance and support throughout the access journey, helping ensure prescriptions and required documentation move efficiently through benefit verification, prior authorization, pharmacy processing, and treatment initiation.

Using pharmacy technician knowledge and experience, the Pharmacy Access Manager supports pharmacy-related case activities, identifies missing or incomplete prescription information, coordinates with pharmacy partners, and helps resolve prescription processing and fulfillment barriers. The role manages each case with a high level of accuracy, responsiveness, and completeness to support timely patient access to therapy.

Core Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end patient access case activities from prescription intake through treatment initiation, including benefit verification, prior authorization support, appeals coordination, affordability support, and pharmacy follow-up.
  • Apply pharmacy technician knowledge to support prescription intake, pharmacy triage, prescription status review, and coordination of pharmacy-related case activities.
  • Review prescription and patient information for completeness and identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent information requiring follow-up with healthcare provider offices, pharmacies, patients, or other stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with specialty, dispensing, and other pharmacy partners regarding prescription receipt, processing status, insurance requirements, patient outreach, affordability considerations, and fulfillment.
  • Monitor prescription progression and proactively identify pharmacy, coverage, authorization, or operational barriers that may delay patient access to therapy.
  • Manage insurance verification and authorization activities to establish coverage, identify applicable medical or pharmacy benefit requirements, and support appropriate access pathways.
  • Support prior authorization and appeals processes by coordinating required information and documentation with healthcare provider offices, payors, pharmacies, and internal teams.
  • Assist with coordination of copay assistance, patient assistance programs, foundation support, or other affordability resources, as applicable to the program.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact between internal and external teams, including patients, providers, payors, pharmacies, facilities, client stakeholders, and other program partners.
  • Provide education and guidance to provider offices regarding program processes, prescription requirements, coverage considerations, required documentation, and available patient support resources.
  • Communicate case status, outstanding requirements, next steps, and barriers clearly and accurately to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Effectively manage and prioritize competing demands, including insurance approval timelines, prescription processing requirements, patient treatment schedules, pharmacy timelines, and stakeholder communications.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and complete case documentation in accordance with program requirements, standard operating procedures, client expectations, and applicable privacy and compliance requirements.
  • Identify complex reimbursement, pharmacy, fulfillment, or patient access issues and escalate appropriately while maintaining ownership of case progression.
  • Collaborate closely with Field Reimbursement Managers and other Patient Services functions, as needed, to support continuity across the patient access journey.
  • Provide support across multiple client programs, as assigned, ensuring consistent delivery of quality service and operational excellence.

Skills & Requirements:

  • Strong knowledge of pharmacy workflows and prescription processing, including prescription intake, pharmacy triage, adjudication, and fulfillment processes.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the role of specialty and dispensing pharmacies within the patient access journey.
  • Proficient in navigating benefit verification, prior authorization, reimbursement, appeals, and patient affordability scenarios.
  • Ability to understand and work across both pharmacy and medical benefit pathways, as applicable.
  • Skilled in reviewing patient, prescription, insurance, and supporting documentation to identify information required for accurate case progression.
  • Ability to identify prescription-processing barriers and coordinate effectively with provider offices, pharmacies, payors, and internal teams to facilitate resolution.
  • Understanding of insurance coverage requirements, payor policies, prior authorization criteria, and reimbursement processes.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate and thorough case documentation.
  • Ability to independently manage a caseload, prioritize work, and consistently meet established timelines and service expectations.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to coordinate multiple priorities, cases, stakeholders, and activities simultaneously.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify barriers, explore alternatives, and develop appropriate solutions while recognizing when escalation or collaboration is needed.
  • Communicates effectively both verbally and in writing, demonstrating professionalism, empathy, clarity, and a commitment to exceptional service.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, pharmacies, payors, and client stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates agility in learning and implementing new processes, systems, products, and program requirements.
  • Operates with a high degree of independence, accountability, follow-through, and resilience.
  • Remains organized, focused, and productive during periods of change or shifting priorities.
  • Demonstrates discretion and professionalism when handling confidential patient and healthcare information.

Education, Certifications and Experience:

  • 2–4 years of experience in a pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, hospital, patient support, healthcare, reimbursement, insurance, or customer service–focused role, including 2+ years as a Pharmacy Technician
  • NABP Certification through either Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) or National Healthcareer Association (ExCPT) certification.
  • Experience with prescription processing, pharmacy benefit coordination, specialty pharmacy operations, or pharmacy-based patient support strongly preferred.
  • Experience with benefit verification, prior authorization, appeals, reimbursement support, copay assistance, or patient assistance programs preferred.
  • Understanding of specialty pharmaceutical markets, reimbursement dynamics, and patient access challenges across diverse payor landscapes preferred.
  • Experience working with healthcare providers, pharmacies, payors, patients, and/or pharmaceutical manufacturer programs preferred.
  • College degree (bachelor’s or associate degree) preferred; relevant pharmacy technician and patient access experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

Physical Requirements:

  • Keyboarding

Job Summary

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is the executive responsible for protecting the organization's information, technology infrastructure, applications, data, and digital services from cyber threats and security risks.

Within Insurance & Investments, the CISO leads enterprise cybersecurity, information security governance, cyber risk management, security architecture, incident response, regulatory compliance, identity and access management, third-party security, and business continuity/cyber resilience.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise cybersecurity and information security strategy.

Establish information security policies, standards, controls, and governance frameworks.

Lead enterprise-wide cybersecurity risk management.

Protect sensitive customer, financial, investment, policyholder, employee, and corporate data.

Oversee:

Security Operations (SOC)

Threat Detection & Response

Incident Response

Security Architecture

Vulnerability Management

Penetration Testing

Identity & Access Management

Endpoint Security

Network Security

Cloud Security

Application Security

Data Security

Establish and manage cyber incident response and crisis-management processes.

Lead security monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, and security testing.

Develop cybersecurity controls across cloud, on-premise, applications, APIs, and digital platforms.

Implement and maintain Identity & Access Management (IAM), privileged access, MFA, and least-privilege controls.

Oversee third-party/vendor cybersecurity risk and technology due diligence.

Ensure security requirements are embedded into digital transformation and technology projects.

Lead security awareness, phishing prevention, and employee cybersecurity training.

Ensure compliance with applicable financial-services, privacy, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements.

Manage security audits, risk assessments, control testing, and remediation programs.

Develop and test Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Cyber Resilience plans.

Establish cybersecurity KPIs, KRIs, dashboards, and executive reporting.

Manage cybersecurity budgets, vendors, managed security providers, and strategic technology partners.

Lead and develop information-security and cybersecurity teams.

Advise the CEO, Board, Risk Committee, Audit Committee, and senior leadership on cyber risk.

Ensure cybersecurity risks are integrated into the organization's overall enterprise risk-management framework.

Insurance & Investments Security Focus

Particularly relevant experience includes protecting:

Insurance

Policyholder/customer data

Claims systems

Underwriting platforms

Actuarial systems

Payment systems

Customer portals

Insurance APIs

Fraud and identity data

Investments / Asset Management

Portfolio and investment systems

Trading platforms

Market and financial data

Investment research

Client/investor information

Custody and transaction systems

Wealth-management platforms

Third-party investment technology

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of IT, cybersecurity, information security, technology risk, or related experience.

7+ years in senior cybersecurity/security leadership.

Previous experience as:

CISO

Group CISO

Chief Information Security Officer

Chief Cybersecurity Officer

Head of Information Security

Head of Cybersecurity

Director of Information Security

Director of Cybersecurity

VP Information Security

VP Cybersecurity

Strong background in Insurance, Banking, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services.

Strong expertise in:

Cybersecurity strategy

Information security governance

Cyber risk management

Security architecture

SOC/SIEM

Incident response

Threat intelligence

Vulnerability management

IAM/PAM

Cloud security

Application security

Network security

Data security

Third-party risk

Business continuity/cyber resilience

Experience with recognized security frameworks and standards such as NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, COBIT, or equivalent.

Strong understanding of financial-services cybersecurity and regulatory requirements.

Demonstrated experience presenting cyber risk to Board/C-suite stakeholders.

Strong leadership, crisis management, risk communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

raw.description:
The Payor Specialist is responsible for verifying and reverifying insurance coverage and eligibility, submitting and following up on authorization requests, and maintaining follow-up communication with insurance companies.

More specifically, this role verifies patient insurance benefits for specific procedure coverage, updates eligibility information, submits and follows up on authorizations and LOA/SCA requests, and requests network or payment related exceptions.

Core Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Works directly in alignment with Case Management Team to coordinate efforts and prioritize daily activities to meet deadlines.
  • Completes insurance benefits verification and reverification to confirm active coverage, benefit details, payor requirements, and applicable patient responsibility.
  • Updates eligibility information accurately and timely based on payor verification and reverification findings.
  • Submits authorization requests when required and performs timely follow-up through final payor determination.
  • Submits Letters of Agreement (LOA) and Single Case Agreements (SCA) when required and performs timely follow-up through rate negotiation, execution, or final payor determination.
  • Obtains timely payor determinations regarding authorizations, LOA/SCA requests, network exceptions, and other payment-related needs, and accurately records and conveys determinations to the Payor Specialist Manager/Case Management Team
  • Tracks and assures compliance with payor requests for information and communicates payor requests to appropriate Payor Specialist Manager/Case Management Team as applicable.
  • Clearly documents and communicates authorization and LOA/SCA outcomes, applicable follow up steps, and payor requirements to the Payor Specialist Manager/Case Management Team.
  • Communicates out-of-network obstacles and takes proactive steps to elevate network status and optimize in-network patient benefits to the Payor Specialist Manager/Case Management Team.
  • Provides feedback to Payor Specialist Manager/Case Management Team as needed regarding payor guidelines, issues, and determinations discovered during communication with payors.
  • Ensures payor and customer satisfaction by utilizing effective communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proactively follows up on pending payor correspondence to encourage priority review and expedited turnaround times.
  • Interprets payor documentation to ensure accuracy and translates appropriately to the Case Management Team, customer, and patient.
  • Follows procedures and instructions to escalate or expedite authorization and LOA/SCA review timelines to meet patient and provider treatment scheduling expectations.
  • Work collaboratively and cross-functionally between management and programs
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Skills / Requirements

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and effective task management while responding productively to changing priorities.
  • Remains calm and objective in emotional or stressful situations.
  • Learns quickly and applies innovative methods, tools, and technology to the role.
  • High level of self-accountability for compliance with policies, procedures, and work requirements.
  • Seeks advice when unsure about choosing a course of action.
  • Makes solid routine decisions with coaching from others.
  • Learns about the key drivers of the organization’s business and uses those learns in the day-to-day work.
  • Maintains tenacity and work focus despite obstacles or setbacks and is comfortable dealing with first- time or unusual challenges.
  • Adequately supports multiple products and/or programs in various treatment specialties
  • Independently manages tasks and follow up responsibilities without direct guidance from management or peers.
  • The need to understand insurance contracts and reimbursement methodologies
  • Ability to effectively navigate payment negotiations within certain rate parameters.
  • Strong expertise in complex insurance framework including but not limited to dual coverage, unique insurance plans, purchase orders, tiered benefits.

Education, Certifications and Experience:

  • Experience with payers and Clinical Guidelines or Medical Policy is preferred.
  • Conversant with medical terminology.
  • Expertise and knowledge of third-party payor, Medicare/Medicaid guidelines.
  • Computer and database management skills to efficiently and effectively manage proprietary electronic systems.
  • Interpersonal and communication skills to effectively deal with a variety of people, including physicians, hospital leaders, nursing staff, patients, and family members.
  • High school diploma with at least five years healthcare experience or Associate's Degree in healthcare-related field with three to four years of experience.

Physical Requirements:

  • As a remote-forward organization, this position operates in a professional virtual office environment and teleworking from the employee’s home address listed in their employment file.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Keyboarding
  • Speaking
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times
  • Flexibility of working hours to support activities across EST to PST zones

Our PRO-Spectus Culture Philosophy

At PRO-Spectus we have created a culture that is supportive, dedicated, and teamwork driven. We celebrate each other’s joys in personal life and professional accomplishments, promoting meaningful relationships and friendships.

Our employees bring strength of mind and spirit to make the extraordinary happen every day. With humility and compassion at our core, PRO-Spectus is proud of our relentless focus towards the higher purpose of improving the lives of patients we support.

We recognize it takes a lot of people working together with a common goal to make spectacular happen, and we never forget that at the heart of our company are the people who make it work.

PRO-Spectus is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status or other protected status under federal, state or local laws.

At PRO-spectus, we are deeply committed to pay transparency and equity. The hourly range for this position is $30 - 41, based on experience and qualifications, with the final offer reflecting skills and other job-related factors. Beyond competitive pay, we offer a comprehensive and generous benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance.

Our benefits include robust medical, dental, and vision plans; life insurance and disability coverage; and tax-advantaged savings accounts. We also provide an Employee Assistance Program, home office benefits, and unique perks like an Employee Ownership Program. With paid time off, holidays, bereavement leave, and a 401(k)-retirement plan with employer matching, PRO-spectus prioritizes your financial and personal security. Plus, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus opportunity.

Join PRO-spectus, where your career growth, well-being, and contributions truly matter!

Specialist I, Incident Management POSITION PROFILE

Responsible for the post-sales support of Ricoh Professional and IT based solutions which include capture, workflow, print management and other Ricoh portfolio-based software solutions. Provides telephone "hotline" and web-based, remote, break/fix technical support for software solutions to dealers, field technicians, VARs, OEMs and/or end user customers.

Responsible for understanding software requirements and delivering highly effective solutions to resolve customer Incidents. Provides expertise in resolving software/application problems requiring remote customer support and for interfacing with vendors or engineering to isolate and solve technical issues on software solutions. The Software Incident Analyst masters a broad range of solutions/enablers and is considered a subject matter expert in three or more Professional or IT Services disciplines. The incident analyst will also replicate caller's software failure or situation in a virtual test laboratory to aid in the diagnosis and ultimately walk the customer through the resolution procedures.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Responds to escalated incidents from Level 1 support calls (i.e. telephone, voicemail, email) in a timely, professional manner. Further evaluates the caller's incident and provides technical assistance utilizing the appropriate support information and documentation. Assumes full ownership of escalated incidents. Analyzes and documents customer technical inquires/issues.
  • Responsible for entries for incoming issues and all activities that pertain to any existing issues within SNOW, KCS, Five9 or any other Incident Management database application. Entries are to be accurate, detailed, and include all required fields with an emphasis on resolution data.
  • Independently conducts tests in controlled lab environment to duplicate and resolve issues.
  • Uses available lab equipment and other virtual or remote resources to effectively troubleshoot issues. Returns resources to proper working condition when through.
  • Provides a specialist skill or support role to receive Incidents that cannot be resolved by Level 1.
  • Investigate and coordinate resolution and recovery actions for assigned Incidents.
  • Proposes and performs billable work for customers following the defined Ricoh service order process.
  • Knowledge of Networking, Databases, rudimentary scripting, Security and Business Processes.
  • Acts as subject matter expert on three or more critical Professional and IT Services disciplines including Workflow, Cloud, Print Management, Behavior Modification, Capture, EDM, IT, Networking, Telephony and server-based fax technology.
  • May assist with installing Ricoh and 3rd party software solutions in customer environments.
  • Develop hardware/software or product specific technical service solutions to escalated incidents of expanded scope.
  • Assists with creating new and updating current documentation.
  • Reviews all technical information pertaining to supported products, including new and updated information as it becomes available.
  • Assists Sr Incident Analysts with developing and conducting internal training for all support tiers.
  • Create, manage and update internal and global knowledgebase to align with prescribed standards.
  • Responsible for the maintenance and safekeeping of a laptop computer and other assigned company property.
  • Installs and maintains current software on assigned workstation.
  • Understands customer requirements for support services; capable of recommending billable services as appropriate & executing on actions necessary to complete the associated tasks.
  • Utilize sophisticated diagnostic tools, service aids, product schematics, and any other available product information in the assessment and resolution of software solutions failure(s).
  • Interface with customer information technology organizations to resolve problems.
  • Maintain their technical certifications, as well as obtain the expertise and knowledge on product & solution training specific to the needs of their role and level.
  • Diagnoses and resolves application, software/hardware and connectivity problems which may require working with on-site technical resources.
  • Partners with the Customer Services team to resolve problems and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Responsible for ongoing personal skill development through the attainment of appropriate certifications and completing assigned training.
  • Performs daily administration of Professional and/or IT Services system of record.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
QUALIFICATIONS (Education, Experience, and Certifications)
  • College degree (computer science, information systems, engineering) or equivalent experience in a related field required.
  • Minimum of 4 years of related work experience including a demonstrated track record of success.
  • In technical support and/or industry related experience, 5+ years preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite, SNOW, Five9 and Visio strongly preferred.
Required Certifications
  • CompTIA A+
  • CompTIA Network+
Additional Certifications
  • Additional certifications may be necessary based on product or technology specific work, i.e.: CNA, CNE, MCP, MCSE, CDIA+, etc.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  • Completes all required administrative tasks in an accurate and timely manner with minimal oversight being required.
  • Requires proficiency in systems analysis - problem isolation, diagnosis, and resolution.
  • Ability to analyze complex data from multiple sources to identify issues and propose solutions.
  • Requires expertise in two or more of the following areas: workflow, behavior modification/cost-recovery, print management, networking, operating systems, Cloud based solutions, IT and Electronic Document Capture and Management.
  • Displays proficient verbal and written communication skills suitable for assessing the issues and relating course of action. Able to communicate effectively with individuals who are under stress or who are themselves poor communicators.
  • Possesses initiative and ability to be highly self-motivated.
  • Project Management Skills (communication, leadership, personal organization etc.).
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Ability to be an agile learner (learning on the fly).
  • Enhanced level of knowledge of computer operating systems, servers and network environments.
  • Advanced level of interpersonal, time management and organizational skills.
WORKING CONDITIONS, MENTAL AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS
  • Typically works in an office environment with adequate lighting, ventilation, and a normal range of temperature and noise level.
  • Shift work, extended hours, stand-by and/or on-call may be required.
  • Requires daily interaction with internal and external contacts via phone, remote or web-based meeting and in person.
  • Work assignments are diversified, ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously is imperative.
  • Work is mostly sedentary but does require walking, standing, bending, reaching, lifting or carrying objects that typically weigh less than 20 lbs. (e.g., papers, books, computers, software, kiosks, parts, etc.)

raw.description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Full Time - Columbia

Job Location: Work at Home, Missouri, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$125.00 - $125.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

Job Title: Sales Representative – Infectious Disease I Region Bayreuth, Regensburg,

Job Location: Germany - Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Über Abbott

Abbott ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen, das bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse nutzt und Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Gesundheit der Menschen entwickelt. Wir blicken stets in die Zukunft und antizipieren Veränderungen in der medizinischen Wissenschaft und Technologie.

In Deutschland ist Abbott mit mehr als 4.000 Mitarbeiter:innen in den Bereichen Forschung und Entwicklung, Logistik, Produktion und Vertrieb vertreten. Neben dem deutschen Hauptsitz in Wiesbaden hat Abbott Standorte in Hannover, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Wetzlar, Eschborn, Jena, Köln und Hamburg.

 

Die Position

Die Position wird an unserem Standort Köln (Abbott Rapid Diagnostics Germany GmbH) im Bereich Infectious Diseases angegliedert und für die Region Bayreuth, Regensburg, Rosenheimverantwortlich sein.

Unser Point-of-Care-Diagnoseportfolio umfasst wichtige Gesundheits- und Therapiebereiche, darunter Infektionskrankheiten, kardiometabolische und Toxikologie.

Unsere diagnostischen Lösungen werden in Krankenhäusern, Laboren und Kliniken rund um den Globus eingesetzt. Die entscheidenden Informationen, die aus unseren Tests, Instrumenten und Informatiksystemen gewonnen werden, sind oft der erste Schritt bei der Entscheidungsfindung in der Patientenversorgung für Hunderte von Gesundheitszuständen, von Herzinfarkten über Blutkrankheiten bis hin zu Infektionskrankheiten und Krebs.

Unsere schnellen Diagnoselösungen tragen dazu bei, einige der größten Herausforderungen der Welt im Gesundheitswesen zu bewältigen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung der Vertriebsziele sowie der kommerziellen Planung zur nachhaltigen Erreichung der Leistungsziele in Ihrer Region
  • Aktive Marktbearbeitung und Kundenentwicklung mit Fokus auf Neukundengewinnung sowie langfristige Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen
  • Verantwortung für die strategische Entwicklung und erfolgreiche Umsetzung des Abbott RDx ID‑Produktportfolios im definierten Vertriebsgebiet
  • Erstellung maßgeschneiderter Angebote, eigenständige Vertragsverhandlungen sowie erfolgreicher Abschluss von Kundenverträgen
  • Beobachtung, Analyse und Reporting von Wettbewerbsaktivitäten, inkl. Ableitung geeigneter Vertriebs‑ und Marktstrategien
  • Durchführung von Produktschulungen, Produktdemonstrationen und Implementierungen bei Kunden vor Ort in der Region
  • Repräsentation von Abbott auf nationalen und internationalen Kongressen, Messen und Fachveranstaltungen

Erforderliche Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Naturwissenschaften, alternativ eine medizinische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung im Bereich Diagnostik
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke sowie sicheres Auftreten gegenüber klinischen Ansprechpartnern
  • Hohe Überzeugungskraft und Fähigkeit, nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln
  • Ergebnisorientierte, strukturierte und resiliente Arbeitsweise in einem dynamischen Umfeld
  • Stark ausgeprägte Problemlösungs- und Kundenorientierung
  • Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Eigeninitiative, Energie und Begeisterungsfähigkeit
  • Sehr gute Organisations‑, Präsentations‑ und Moderationsfähigkeiten
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft (ca. 70–80 %) innerhalb des Vertriebsgebiets
  • Fließende Deutsch - sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb der Medizintechnik‑, Diagnostik‑ oder Pharmaindustrie
  • Gutes Verständnis des Secondary‑Care‑ bzw. Klinikmarktes
  • Unternehmerisches Mindset, Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit in einem sich wandelnden Marktumfeld
  • Souveräne, wirksame Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf allen Entscheidungsebenen
  • Fähigkeit, Kundenbedarfe und Geschäftspotenziale klar zu analysieren, zu adressieren und in langfristige strategische Partnerschaften zu überführen – auch mit Kunden von nationaler Bedeutung

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann bewerben Sie sich bei uns.  

Wir freuen uns auf Sie! 

Arbeiten bei Abbott

Bei Abbott finden Sie eine Aufgabe, die wirklich zählt, denn Sie verhelfen anderen Menschen zu einem gesünderen und erfüllten Leben. Wachsen Sie mit uns und lernen Sie stetig dazu – Sie können hier Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung vorantreiben und sich selbst verwirklichen.

Das erwartet Sie bei uns:

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem internationalen Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Karriere machen können, von der Sie träumen
  • Ein attraktives Benefit-Paket (z.B. Company Bike, Mitarbeiteraktienkaufprogramm)
  • Eine herausfordernde Position in einer schnell wachsenden krisenunabhängigen Branche
  • Die Möglichkeit, Teil eines dynamischen, hochqualifizierten und motivierten Teams zu werden
  • Flache Hierarchien, offene, wertschätzende Mentalität und effiziente, konstruktive Kommunikationswege
  • Ein multinationales Umfeld, in dem wir die Entwicklung unserer Talente innerhalb des Unternehmens fördern
  • Ein Unternehmen, das als eine der “Best Big Companies To Work For“ anerkannt ist, sowie als bester Platz zum Arbeiten für Vielfalt, arbeitende Mütter, weibliche Führungskräfte und Wissenschaftler:innen

Folgen Sie Ihren Karrierezielen bei Abbott für vielfältige Möglichkeiten mit einem Unternehmen, das Ihnen helfen kann, Ihre Zukunft aufzubauen und Ihr bestes Leben zu führen. Abbott ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit, der sich der Vielfalt der Mitarbeiter verschrieben hat.

Schwerbehinderte Bewerber:innen werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.

raw.description:
Voici un poste à distance.

En tant que Community Manager, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la communication digitale de REMI LEDE. Vous serez chargé(e) de développer notre visibilité en ligne, d’engager notre communauté et de refléter nos valeurs à travers des contenus percutants et engageants.

Vos missions principales :

  1. Stratégie de contenu :

    • Concevoir et planifier le calendrier éditorial en accord avec notre stratégie globale.
    • Créer des contenus variés (posts, stories, vidéos, articles) pour nos réseaux sociaux et blog.

  2. Animation de la communauté :

    • Modérer les interactions et répondre aux commentaires/messages.
    • Stimuler l’engagement et la fidélisation de notre communauté.

  3. Développement des réseaux sociaux :

    • Identifier les tendances et opportunités pour augmenter notre audience.
    • Proposer et mettre en œuvre des campagnes digitales (jeux concours, collaborations).

  4. Analyse et reporting :

    • Suivre les performances (KPI) de nos contenus et proposer des axes d’amélioration.
    • Préparer des rapports mensuels sur l’engagement et l’audience.

  5. Collaboration inter-équipe :

    • Travailler avec l’équipe créative pour assurer une cohérence visuelle et éditoriale.
    • Participer aux réunions d’équipe et sessions de brainstorming.
Attention, nous cherchons quelqu'un d'engagé qui souhaites s'offrir une opportunité de type reconversion ou opportunité d'évolution puisque nous sommes une start-Up en recherche de talents. Ainsi, si vous êtes par exemple en poste mais que vous cherchez quelque chose à côté, il est possible de candidater à nos côtés et de commencer à vous offrir ce tremplin professionnel.

Profil

Vos compétences :

  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, avec un ton authentique et engageant.
  • Bonne connaissance des principales plateformes sociales (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.).
  • Maîtrise de logiciels de création (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite est un plus).
  • Capacité à analyser des données et à les transformer en recommandations stratégiques.

Vos qualités humaines :

  • Créativité, curiosité et proactivité.
  • Forte capacité d’adaptation et autonomie.
  • Esprit d’équipe et sens de l’écoute.
  • Intérêt pour les valeurs de minimalisme, nature, et bien-être.

Les bonus :

  • Une première expérience en gestion de communauté est un plus.
  • Parler anglais couramment est un avantage, mais non obligatoire.
  • Parler espagnol couramment est un avantage, mais non obligatoire.
Nous cherchons avant tout une personne qui souhaites lors de ce stage non rémunéré de 2 mois, apprendre de nouvelles choses ou s'offrir une opportunité au sein de notre future start-Up puisque si la personne en question travail bien, elle pourra naturellement se qualifier pour un futur poste en CDI dès lors que nous lèverons les fonds pour notre société. PS : Futur poste de directeur marketing à la clés pour les plus ambitieux ou travailleur.

Informations contractuelles

Ce stage est d’une durée de 2 mois, non rémunéré, en télétravail à 100%.

Nous sommes une startup en démarrage, bâtissant les fondations d’un projet ambitieux et visionnaire. Partir de zéro est un défi que nous relevons chaque jour avec passion et détermination. Nous croyons en l’avenir de notre entreprise et travaillons actuellement à lever des fonds, une étape cruciale prévue tout au long de 2025.

Ce stage constitue une réelle opportunité pour vous :
Si vous démontrez votre engagement et vos compétences, un poste à responsabilités pourra vous être proposé dès que notre levée de fonds sera finalisée.

Rejoindre REMI LEDE, c’est entrer dans une aventure unique où chaque contribution compte pour construire un projet à fort impact.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Senior AWS Cloud Administrator

Job Summary

We are seeking an experiencedAWS Cloud Administratorwith 7-8 years of overall IT experience and strong expertise in AWS Cloud infrastructure management, administration, monitoring, security, networking and cost optimization. Candidate will be responsible for managing production cloud environments, ensuring high availability, implementing security best practices, supporting cloud migrations, and driving operational excellence across AWS workloads.

Experience Required

  • 7-8 Years Overall IT Experience

  • Minimum 5+ years managing AWS production environments.

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale cloud workloads.

  • Strong background in Linux/Windows administration, networking, security, and automation.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Manage, monitor, and maintain AWS production, staging, and development environments.

  • Provision and administer AWS resources using infrastructure best practices.

  • Design and maintain highly available and fault-tolerant cloud environments.

  • Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and resource optimization.

  • Manage multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations.

  • Administer EC2 instances, AMIs, Auto Scaling Groups, and Launch Templates.

  • Manage Elastic Load Balancers (ALB/NLB).

  • Configure and maintain EBS, EFS, FSx, and S3 storage services.

  • Perform storage lifecycle management and optimization.

  • Manage VPCs, Subnets, Route Tables, NAT Gateways, Internet Gateways, and Security Groups.

  • Troubleshoot network connectivity and routing issues.

  • Configure VPN, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and VPC Peering.

  • Implement network security and segmentation best practices.

  • Manage AWS IAM Users, Groups, Roles, and Policies.

  • Implement least-privilege access controls.

  • Configure MFA, AWS SSO, and identity federation.

  • Support security hardening and compliance requirements.

  • Review and remediate security findings.

  • Implement AWS Backup solutions.

  • Configure automated snapshots and retention policies.

  • Develop and test disaster recovery procedures.

  • Maintain backup compliance and recovery objectives (RPO/RTO).

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions.

  • Automate cloud deployment and operational tasks.

  • Support CI/CD and DevOps integration initiatives.

  • Strong knowledge of ITSM process and tool – Incident ,Change ,Problem Management.

Cost Optimization & Governance

  • Monitor AWS spend using Cost Explorer and AWS Budgets.

  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and right-sizing recommendations.

  • Optimize Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and storage costs.

SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms.

We are helping companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end.

A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future!

About the Role

Join us in shaping the next generation of digital customer experiences in the financial services industry. As a Senior / Lead Developer for Core Data Services, you will drive technical architecture decisions, lead implementation activities on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), and help deliver scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions in a highly collaborative environment.

In this role, you will take end-to-end technical ownership for Core Data Services development within a large-scale customer portal transformation program. You will combine hands-on development with technical leadership, guiding architecture decisions, mentoring developers, and ensuring the successful delivery of SAP BTP-based solutions through to go-live.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of Core Data Services for customer-facing portal applications on SAP BTP and SAP RISE, following Clean Core principles.
  • Define and maintain technical and architecture concepts, support quality gates, and ensure alignment with project and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Design and implement modular services using the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP), including integrations through the SAP BTP Integration Suite.
  • Establish secure authentication and authorization concepts, including XSUAA, role management, and access control frameworks.
  • Provide technical leadership to the development team through code reviews, mentoring, release governance, documentation, and deployment readiness activities.

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on software development experience on SAP BTP, ideally within Clean Core transformation projects.
  • Proven expertise with RAP and/or CAP and the development of enterprise-grade cloud applications.
  • Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security concepts on SAP BTP, including XSUAA and role-based access management.
  • Practical experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, Agentic AI concepts, and Human-in-the-Loop implementation approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of architecture and solution design, while leading delivery within agile development teams.

Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in AI-enabled solutions and services on SAP BTP.
  • Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP Integration Suite, and API management capabilities.
  • Previous experience leading small development teams within banking, public funding, or regulated financial environments.
  • German language skills.

Benefits

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all — the agility, enthusiasm, and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence, and extensive customer network of a more established organization.

At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and empowers you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you can chart your career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes occupational pension provisions, support for health and wellbeing, various mobility options like bike leasing and transportation allowances, as well as additional perks such as celebration rewards, jubilee recognition, and relocation reimbursement.

About Carda

Rehab is a pain. So much so that only 10% of qualifying Cardiac and Pulmonary patients attend. At Carda Health, we’ve reimagined rehab. Our program allows patients to complete inspiring, convenient, life-saving therapy remotely.

Who are we?

We are a team of clinicians, data scientists, mathematicians and repeat entrepreneurs. And a few recovering financiers. Our belief is that technology and data, when applied to the right problem, transforms people’s lives and changes even the most entrenched industries. Carda was founded by Harry and Andrew, two friends from Wharton who share a family history of heart disease and experience with poor access to care. We now work with some of America’s largest and top-ranked hospitals and most innovative insurers. We are fortunate to be backed by some of the best investors in the business who have also backed the likes of Livongo, Hinge, Calm, MDLive, and others.

Who are you?

You're energized by the dynamic environment of a rapidly growing startup. Detail-oriented yet capable of aligning tasks with broader company objectives, you're dedicated to enhancing operational efficiency and expanding access to transformative therapies. Your hallmark trait is ownership, driving you to rectify inefficiencies and drive results. Adept at collaboration and communication, you excel in both team management and cross-functional initiatives, achieving outcomes swiftly and effectively.

Position Overview:

The Member Experience Specialist is the first line of support for Carda Health patients. In this role, you will guide patients from enrollment through their first clinical session, ensuring a smooth and welcoming experience. Responsibilities include coordinating appointments, troubleshooting technology issues, and providing ongoing support to keep patients engaged throughout their care. This position blends patient advocacy, operational excellence, and strong communication to deliver a seamless member experience.

Key Responsibilities:
Patient Onboarding & Support

  • Welcome new patients and confirm delivery of care packages and equipment.
  • Facilitate initial telehealth visits and conduct care package walkthroughs.
  • Guide patients through device setup and navigation of the Carda Health app.
  • Provide clear instructions and ongoing support to ensure patient comfort with technology and program participation.

Telehealth Workflow Management

  • Manage check-in and check-out processes for telehealth appointments.
  • Coordinate with providers and internal teams to ensure smooth appointment flow and follow-up.

Communication & Advocacy

  • Serve as part of the frontline support team for patients, answering questions and resolving issues with empathy and efficiency.
  • Keep patients engaged, motivated, and informed throughout their care journey.

Operational Excellence

  • Accurately document all patient interactions in Salesforce and related systems.
  • Track care package deliveries, referrals, and enrollment statuses to ensure no patient is left behind.
  • Collaborate with clinical, growth, and operations teams to address patient needs and improve workflows.

What we look for:

  • 1–3 years of experience in healthcare support, customer success, or another patient-facing role (Telehealth experience preferred).
  • Strong communication skills, with an ability to connect effectively with older adult populations (65+).
  • Comfortable with technology and able to quickly learn new software (experience with Salesforce, EHR, or CRM systems are a plus).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathetic, patient-focused, and passionate about improving healthcare access and outcomes.

Nice to Haves:

  • Sales or Retention Experience: Background in customer success, inside sales, or patient retention to help address common objections and keep patients engaged in their care program.
  • Objection Handling Skills: Ability to listen empathetically, reframe concerns, and guide patients toward staying in the program by reinforcing value and trust.
  • Experience with Older Adult Populations (65+): Comfort working with seniors, understanding their typical questions, concerns, and hesitations, and tailoring communication styles accordingly.
  • Motivational Communication: Skilled at encouraging patients to overcome resistance to technology, remote care, or ongoing participation.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Demonstrated ability to anticipate patient concerns (cost, technology, time commitment) and proactively provide solutions.
  • Healthcare or Insurance Knowledge: Familiarity with Medicare/insurance basics to answer common patient questions and reduce confusion around coverage.
  • Confidentiality: Understanding of HIPAA and patient privacy regulations.

Why Join Carda Health?

  • Be part of a mission-driven company dedicated to improving lives for patients with chronic conditions.
  • Fully remote role with a supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Opportunity to grow and develop within a rapidly scaling healthcare startup.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote role, you can live and work anywhere in UK, France or Germany

About the Role

The Solution Architect as a seasoned proficient professional will be an influential and senior level memberof our Consulting Team, who will understand our customers’ most pressing business performancechallenges and will be committed to helping our customers solve complex issues in their supply chainmanagement practice. The incumbent will be responsible for working with new and existing customers,provide expert guidance in integrating our product offerings so that our customers can start to experiencethe immediate value of Kinaxis solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Articulate the value of the Kinaxis solution throughout the customer journey and serve as aproduct and supply chain subject matter expert.
  • Lead workshops with customers to understand and document supply chain softwarerequirements, as well as define objectives and targets for software implementations withmultiple levels of complexity.
  • Define the overall systems architecture and data flow for customers business needs, includingboth standard and unique software functionalities to be used as well as any software extensionsneeded.
  • Identify risks and develop mitigation plans for deployments.
  • Coach and delegate configuration tasks to project team members.
  • Resolve complex data and analytics configurations to ensure the solution is producing theexpected results.
  • Oversee the successful validation and testing of the solution as well as data management anddata integration related activities.
  • Provide functional leadership and recommendations during critical deployment escalations or toresolve complex supply chain challenges. Mentor and support all levels of solution consultantsthroughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Influence internal functions to shape the product roadmap and work on solutions that meetcustomer needs or new industries.
  • Participate in services sales opportunities to highlight the value of Maestro implementation andmethodology. Present complex information concisely to business stakeholders up to executivelevel roles

Primary Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research,Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology or a related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of broad experience in software implementation consulting in the supplychain planning or supply chain execution space or business experience in supply planning,demand planning, inventory management, or manufacturing.
  • At least 3 direct years as a solution architect or lead functional consultant for enterprise levelsupply chain transformation projects.
  • Excellent facilitation skills, adept communicator skilled at managing customer and stakeholderinteractions.
  • Self-starter who shows initiative in their work and learning and can excel in a fast-paced, matrixwork environment.
  • Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills, able to synthesize a high volume of complexinformation to determine and lead teams towards best course of action.
  • Proven leadership, interpersonal and coaching/mentoring capabilities within a dedicated,matrixed work team.Role Specific Skills and experience
  • Subject matter expert in supply chain concepts and best practices coupled with in-depthexperience with supply chain solutions and applications (such as Maestro, SAP, Oracle or BlueYonder).
  • Experience producing complex blueprints on business processes and translating to technicalrequirements during software implementations.
  • Technical leadership experience in data integration, data management, system configurationand system deployment for supply chain software implementations.
  • Proficiency with SQL, R and/or Java Script.
  • Open to travel 75% on average and 100% occasionally and can work effectively when workingremotely from client sites.

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

Preferred Qualifications

What We Offer:

This role has incredible potential for the right person to shape and grow a region.

If you thrive on selling complex, cross-portfolio SaaS solutions into industrial and scientific markets, navigating intricate multi-stakeholder buying processes, collaborating across a large matrixed organization, and leading a team through ambitious growth targets — this role is for you.

In this role you will get to:

Lead Territory & Named Account Strategy: Own the design and execution of a segmented go-to-market approach across EMEA — balancing territory coverage with focused, strategic named accounts across life sciences/pharma, specialty chemicals, CPG, F&B, F&F, and energy. Sell Across the Full Digital Thread: Position and sell solutions spanning ELN, LIMS, CDS, SDMS, PLM, MES, and Enterprise Cloud/SaaS platforms — connecting R&D, Tech Transfer, and Production into a single digital thread. Translate the value of Data Science & Analytics, AI, and agentic/orchestration capabilities into compelling narratives for scientific, operational, IT, and executive audiences.

Solution Selling with Impact: Coach your team to go beyond the software and solve critical business and scientific challenges — ensuring pitches are customized to resonate with scientists, plant and quality leaders, IT, and C-suite stakeholders across multiple industries.

Pipeline Generation Powerhouse: Direct pipeline-building efforts across multiple personas within each account, leveraging an established global user base, ABM, cold outreach, warm referrals, partner-sourced leads, and events. Ensure the team has the coverage and tools to execute consistently.

Negotiation & Closing Excellence: Support and unblock complex, multi-national negotiations from discovery to signature, helping the team navigate organizational and procurement complexity to secure high-value, 7-figure+ deals.

Strategic Account Management: Build trust and long-term partnerships across named accounts, ensuring solutions align to both scientific/technical goals and broader operational and business objectives.

You're comfortable selling into accounts where budget isn't pre-established, and you know how to build the business case that creates it.

The key skills we are looking for:

This opportunity is ideal for investment banking professionals interested in applying their industry expertise to innovative projects at the intersection of finance and artificial intelligence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and refine financial deliverables, including pitchbooks, valuation models, and market analysis reports, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and professional standards.

Project Focus

The assignment combines practical investment banking expertise with advanced AI development, enabling financial professionals to contribute directly to improving how AI systems interpret financial information and perform complex analytical tasks.

QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience

  • Current or recent experience as an Investment Banking Associate, a second-year or more senior Investment Banking Analyst, or in an equivalent Sales & Trading role.
  • Demonstrated expertise in financial modeling, business valuation, financial analysis, and investment banking transaction processes.
  • Practical knowledge of deal execution, transaction structuring, and capital markets.

Technical Skills

  • Strong ability to interpret and analyze financial statements, valuation models, transaction documents, and market data.
  • Experience reviewing financial models, pitchbooks, investment presentations, and other investment banking documentation.
  • Familiarity with industry-standard financial documentation, regulatory considerations, and deal structuring practices.
  • Ability to identify financial inconsistencies, evaluate complex analytical content, and provide technically accurate recommendations.

Communication & Analytical Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial concepts clearly and precisely.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong analytical thinking, critical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to provide constructive, detailed, and actionable feedback on complex financial materials.

Professional Competencies

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple deliverables within established project milestones.
  • Strong organizational skills and effective time management.

  • Professional judgment, adaptability, and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

Employment Type: Independent Contractor

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote

Compensation: USD $120–$150 per hour.

Project Type: Specialized Artificial Intelligence Training and Evaluation – Investment Banking & Financial Services.

Work Environment: Remote collaboration with project coordinators, with assignments focused on financial analysis, investment banking expertise, and AI model evaluation.

raw.title: Solutions Strategist
raw.excerpt: Vaan is a Shopify Platinum design & technology agency and the home of Brand Conversion Design.
raw.description:
Vaan is a Shopify Platinum design & technology agency and the home of Brand Conversion Design.

We migrate, design, and build high performing eCommerce experiences leveraging our Brand Conversion Design framework, industry partnerships & deep eCommerce technical expertise. Solving the tension between optimization and design, we help brands make the most of their eCommerce.

About the role

Vaan partners with direct-to-consumer and B2B brands from $5M to $1B in GMV, across new builds, platform migrations, and ongoing optimization retainers. Our work spans development, design, A/B testing, and strategic roadmapping in one of the fastest-moving platform environments in commerce.

The Solutions Strategist sits between client understanding and technical execution. This is not a developer role and does not require one. It requires someone who can walk into a complex merchant environment, understand how systems connect, identify friction, and turn that into a requirements picture engineering and design can build against.

We value specificity over generalism, forward-thinking over comfort with the status quo, and partners over vendors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery for new engagements, migrations, and major projects, surfacing the requirements others miss
  • Run structured sessions with client stakeholders across technical, marketing, and ops functions, and turn what surfaces into documentation the full team can act on
  • Translate ambiguous business needs into scoped functional and technical requirements, including an explicit account of what is out of scope and why
  • Decompose requirements into epics and stories an engineer can pick up without a follow-up conversation, working alongside the Product Owner to keep the backlog accurate as the engagement moves
  • Maintain the requirements record page by page and section by section, covering features and functions, metafields, and the apps in play, with every line traceable to scope
  • Work with Tech Leads to document architecture, data flows, and business rules, and to validate feasibility and scope before requirements become commitments
  • Build and maintain the discovery frameworks and templates the rest of the team works from
  • Translate what a client asks for into what they actually need, then identify the tool that serves it, with reasoning legible to the client, engineering, and the account team
  • Maintain working awareness of what is already implemented across our portfolio, so recommendations build on existing stack decisions instead of duplicating or contradicting them
  • Evaluate third-party tools across loyalty, search, reviews, personalization, subscriptions, and headless commerce, knowing each category well enough to ask the right questions and judge honestly
  • Recognize when someone else on the team knows a tool better than you, and pull them in early
  • Track Shopify platform updates, deprecations, and roadmap signals, and translate what changes into client guidance
  • Advise on stack composition with a focus on long-term maintainability, scalability, and cost
  • Map complex client environments across ERPs, PIMs, OMS platforms, CRM systems, and marketing stacks, including how they connect and where Shopify fits
  • Identify integration requirements, data flows, and failure points before they become project risks
  • Audit existing Shopify implementations for technical debt, architectural gaps, and unused platform capability, and articulate what should change and why
  • Understand how AI works inside the apps our clients already run. Most of the ecosystem is adding AI features across search, merchandising, personalization, support, and retention. The question is never whether the feature exists. It is whether turning it on moves a business objective this client actually has
  • Hold a working read on where AI creates genuine value in ecommerce and where it is noise, and be able to explain the difference to a client without hedging
  • Identify where AI-enabled tooling could improve conversion, retention, or operational efficiency for a client, and build the case
  • Use AI in your own delivery work: drafting specs, scripting audits, analyzing rulesets, reconciling data, roughing out wireframes to move a conversation along
  • Work as a peer to Growth Strategists. You are the reason a commercially attractive roadmap item is deliverable, or the reason it gets reshaped before it is promised to a client
  • Contribute technical context to scoping and estimation that makes the numbers more accurate
  • Keep engineering, design, and the account team working from the same requirements picture, and surface the conflict early when they are not

Qualifications

  • A track record of picking the right tool for a specific client context and being able to defend the choice to both the client and the engineers who have to live with it
  • Working familiarity with Shopify Plus across admin, metafields, theme architecture, and B2B, enough to reason about what is possible without needing to build it
  • Understanding of headless and composable architectures, and of when they are the wrong call
  • Comfort saying you do not know a tool well, and a habit of finding the person who does
  • A track record of leading discovery on complex digital projects, with documentation habits that survive contact with a deadline
  • Ability to run stakeholder sessions that surface the real requirements, meaning what clients actually need rather than what they say they want
  • Experience writing requirements engineering can execute against with minimal ambiguity, and breaking them down to a granularity a developer can pick up
  • Experience holding requirements for several clients at once without context bleeding between them
  • Exposure to platform migration from Magento, BigCommerce, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud to Shopify Plus
  • Working comfort in Figma or FigJam, Jira, and Excel. You don't need mastery. You should be able to run a session on a canvas, author a story, and keep a structured requirements sheet clean
  • Experience evaluating AI features inside tools a merchant already pays for, rather than only standalone AI products, and judging whether switching one on is worth the change
  • Comfort with rapid change. You update your position when the evidence warrants it, and you say so out loud
  • Confident in client-facing environments, able to ask hard questions diplomatically and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Able to propose a compromise a client will accept, an engineer will respect, and the account team can still deliver inside the SOW
  • Strong written communication. Your requirements documents, briefs, and follow-ups are clear and trusted by the people who use them

Reporting to the Manager, Retirement & Benefits, the Retirement & Benefits Specialist will support employee benefits, retirement, leave, disability, and wellness administration for U.S. programs. This role is responsible for the administration, communication, reporting, compliance support, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement of U.S. benefits, retirement, and leave programs while helping deliver a consistent, high-quality employee experience.

As a subject matter expert for U.S. benefits, retirement, and leave administration, this role will support health and welfare programs, retirement plans, employee leaves, vendor partnerships, eligibility processes, employee education, reporting, and Dayforce-related benefits data administration. The Specialist will partner closely with employees, leaders, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Finance, Legal, HRIS, benefit carriers, retirement providers, brokers, leave administrators, and other external partners to ensure programs are administered accurately, consistently, and effectively.

This role requires sound judgment, discretion, analytical thinking, strong attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage day-to-day administration while supporting process improvements, annual renewal activities, open enrollment, and project initiatives in a fast-paced U.S. benefits environment. This position is a virtual position, but we are looking to hire someone in the Rochester, NY or Wayne, PA area. What you'll do

  • Administers U.S. health and welfare benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug, life insurance, disability, voluntary benefits, Health Savings Accounts (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), wellness programs, employee eligibility, enrollments, life events, terminations, and carrier or vendor integrations.
  • Administers U.S. retirement programs, including 401(k) plan activities, employee enrollments, contribution changes, employee education, vendor coordination, compliance support, annual testing, audit requests, and plan-related reporting.
  • Coordinates U.S. leave and disability programs, including FMLA, applicable state leaves, ADA accommodation support, Paid Family Leave, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and related case administration in partnership with employees, managers, HR stakeholders, and third-party administrators.
  • Serves as a primary subject matter expert for U.S. benefits, retirement, leave, disability, and wellness programs by providing clear, accurate, and timely guidance to employees, managers, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Finance, and other key stakeholders.
  • Researches and resolves complex employee, eligibility, enrollment, billing, payroll deduction, vendor, and data issues while applying plan provisions, established processes, and sound judgment; escalates complex or high-risk matters as appropriate.
  • Develops, updates, and delivers employee communications, FAQs, presentations, training materials, and other education materials that improve understanding and support a positive employee experience.
  • Coordinates day-to-day relationships with benefit carriers, brokers, retirement providers, leave administrators, HRIS partners, and other third-party vendors to support effective administration, issue resolution, service performance, and timely escalation of operational concerns.
  • Reviews, reconciles, and validates benefit invoices, HSA funding, retirement funding, vendor reporting, payroll deductions, employee contributions, carrier files, and HRIS data to support billing accuracy, data integrity, and financial controls.
  • Supports benefits budgeting, forecasting, renewal analysis, cost modeling, utilization review, vendor reporting, open enrollment planning, and leadership-ready summaries that inform program recommendations and business decisions.
  • Supports compliance with applicable federal and state requirements, including ACA, ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, ADA, state leave regulations, required notices, nondiscrimination testing, plan documentation, regulatory reporting, audits, and recordkeeping obligations.
  • Identifies, recommends, and implements process improvements that strengthen controls, simplify administration, reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, enhance vendor accountability, and improve the overall employee and stakeholder experience.
  • Maintains accurate and confidential documentation, records, case notes, reports, and plan administration materials in accordance with company standards, privacy expectations, and applicable compliance requirements.
  • ​​Performs other related duties as assigned.​

What you bring

  • ​​University Degree or Professional Certification​
  • ​​Intermediate Experience – More than three years and less than five years​
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. health and welfare benefits, retirement plans, leave administration, and related requirements, including ACA, ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, ADA, and applicable state leave programs.
  • Knowledge of benefits funding, invoice reconciliation, eligibility processes, data audits, regulatory reporting, and plan documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and Dayforce benefits administration, reporting, data validation, and workflow processes.
  • Works independently within established policies, plan provisions, and governance requirements to manage day-to-day U.S. benefits and retirement administration.
  • Researches and resolves complex employee, data, billing, eligibility, and vendor issues; identifies risk and escalates matters requiring leadership, legal, or strategic direction.
  • Uses sound judgment, data, and operational knowledge to recommend process improvements and practical solutions.
