Director,ProductManager–Managed Security Services

Location:US Remote, Easternor Central timepreferred

About VikingCloud

VikingCloud delivers cybersecurity and compliance solutions that simply work. Our expert-led approach combines proven technology and AI-driven insights with dedicated support—keeping businesses secure, audit-ready, and uninterrupted.

VikingCloud is trusted by over 4 million business locations in 70+ countries to stop threats before they stop business, so they can work on what matters most. For more information, visitand follow us at

This Position

As the Director,ProductVikingCloud, you will lead the go-to-market strategy, revenue growth, and market positioning for our expanding security operations portfolioon the direct side of our business, with a particular focus on Managed Security ServicesThis senior leadership role is focused primarily on driving commercial success forVikingCloud'sMSS offerings, with additional ownership of our endpoint security portfolio,through strategic partnerships, customer engagement, sales enablement, and competitive differentiation. You will be the external face ofVikingCloud'ssecurity services, engaging with customers, prospects, partners, industry analysts, and the broader cybersecurity community. Working with our internal product teams, you will ensureVikingCloud'sMSS and endpoint services meet market demands while positioning the company as a leader in integrated compliance and security solutions for SMB merchants, multi-location and franchise brands,and financial institutions. Reporting to the Head of Product, you will drive revenue growth, customer acquisition, market expansion, and strategic partnerships while collaborating with sales, marketing, and operations to achieve business objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Go-To-Market Strategy & Execution:Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies forVikingCloud'smanaged security services and endpoint security portfolio. Define target customer segments — with particular focus on multi-location, franchise, and distributed retail environments —value propositions, pricing models, and sales motions. Create market entrystrategies for new verticals and geographies. Drive revenue growth through both direct sales and channel partnerships.
  • Sales Enablement & Revenue Growth: Partner with sales leadership to build sales playbooks, competitive battle cards, ROI calculators, proof-of-value frameworks, and win/loss strategies. Conduct sales training onMSS and endpointpositioning, technical differentiation, and objection handling. Support complex enterprise sales cycles through executive engagement, technical validation, and customer presentations. Establish revenue targets and track performance against goals.
  • Customer Engagement & Acquisition:Serve as primary contact for strategic customers and key prospects. Conduct customer discovery sessions, executive briefings, and quarterly business reviews. Build trusted advisor relationships with CISOs, CTOs, security leaders, and franchise/multi-site operations executives. Present at customer events, webinars, and industry conferences. Drive customer success and expansion revenue throughupselland cross-sell opportunities with compliance services.
  • Market Positioning & Competitive Strategy:OwnVikingCloud'scompetitive positioning in themanaged security services and endpoint securitymarket against players like Arctic Wolf, Rapid7, Huntress, and traditional MSSPs. Articulate clear differentiation based on compliance integration,multi-locationmerchant security expertise, and hybrid platform + SOC model. Monitor competitive landscape and adjust positioning as market evolves. Develop messaging and content that resonates with target buyers.
  • Strategic Partnerships & Channel Development:Establish and manage partnerships with technology vendors (EDR, SIEM, threat intelligence), resellers, and industry alliances. Build channel programs for acquirer partners and payment processors to white-label or resellVikingCloud'sMSS and endpointservices. Negotiate partnership agreements and joint go-to-market initiatives. Drive partner-sourced revenue growth.
  • SOC Relationship & Performance:Ensure service level agreements aremetand customer satisfaction remains high. Conduct regular performance reviews and drive continuous improvement. Escalate and resolve operational issues affecting customers. Position SOC partnership as strategic advantage in market conversations.
  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Influence:Define market requirements and customer needs that inform theMSS and endpointproduct roadmap. Gather competitive intelligence and customer feedback to guide product priorities. Represent market perspective in product planningdiscussions. EnsureVikingCloud'sMSS and endpointcapabilities remain competitive and aligned with market demands. Balance customer requests with strategic product direction.
  • Marketing Collaboration & Demand Generation:Partner with marketing to develop messaging, positioning, content, case studies, and demand generation campaigns. Create compelling value propositions for different buyer personas. Support analyst relations with Gartner, Forrester, and industry research firms. Contribute thought leadership through conference speaking, blogs, and media engagement.Driveinbound and outbound lead generation.
  • Customer Success & Retention:Design customer onboarding processes, success metrics, and engagement models forMSS and endpointservices. Define health scores and early warning indicators for at-risk customers. Establish executive sponsorship programs for enterprise accounts. Drive high NPS scores and customer retention rates. Create customer advocacy programs and reference-able customers.
  • Financial Management & Business Planning:Develop business cases, revenue projections, and P&L forecasts forMSS and endpointservices. Optimize pricing strategies and packaging to maximize revenue and margins. Track key business metrics including bookings, ARR, customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), and gross margins.Reportfinancial performance and business results to leadership.
  • Industry Engagement & Thought Leadership:Represent VikingCloud at industry conferences, roundtables, and trade shows. Build relationships with industry analysts, media, and influencers. Participate in industry working groups and standards bodies. Establish VikingCloud as a thought leader in merchant security, payment security, and integrated compliance/security solutions. Create visibility and brand awareness in target markets.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy:Conduct market research onmanaged security and endpoint securitytrends, emerging threats, customer buying behaviors, and competitive dynamics. Monitor regulatory changes and compliance requirements affecting security services. Identify new market opportunities and adjacent services to expandVikingCloud'sportfolio. Provide strategic recommendationstoexecutive leadership on market direction and investment priorities.
  • Technicalexpertise:"Thisrole calls for a product leader with real technical depth in Managed Security Services (MSS): someone who understands SOC operations, detection and response workflows, and the underlying security tooling well enough to make sound product decisions, not just relay requirements from engineering. You should be able to hold your own in a technicalconversation with security analysts and then translate that depth into a clear, prioritized roadmap."

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, cybersecurity, computer science, or related field required; MBA strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity with at least 5 years in commercial leadership roles focused on go-to-market, sales, business development, or product marketing for security products or services.
  • Proven track record of revenue growth inMSS, MSSP, endpoint security, or cybersecurity SaaS markets. Experience selling to SMB, mid-market, and enterprise customers in financial services, payments, retail, or franchiseverticals highly valuable.
  • Direct experience serving multi-location, franchise, or distributed-enterprise customers (e.g., retail chains, restaurant/QSR franchises, hospitality, convenience and fuel) where managed network and endpoint security must be standardized, priced, and delivered consistently across hundreds or thousands of sites with limited on-site IT staff.
  • Deep understanding ofthe managed security services and endpoint securitymarket landscape including competitive dynamics, buyer personas, sales cycles, pricing models, and differentiation strategies. Knowledge of key players like CrowdStrike,SentinelOne,Arctic Wolf, Rapid7, and traditional MSSPs.
  • Strong technical fluency in security operations concepts including EDR/endpoint protection,managed firewall and network security,SIEM, threat detection, incident response, and threat intelligence. Ability to articulate technical value to both technical and business audiences without requiring hands-on implementation experience.Experience with Bitdefender —VikingCloud'splatform for AV, EDR, and full-disk encryption (FDE) —is preferred.
  • Demonstrated success in sales enablement, pre-sales engineering, or product evangelism roles. Experience building sales playbooks, competitive positioning, and supporting complex B2B sales cycles.
  • Outstanding customer-facing skills with proven ability to engage C-level executives (CISOs, CTOs, CFOs) and build trusted advisor relationships. Comfort presenting to large audiences and small boardrooms alike.
  • Experience with compliance frameworks (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST) and ability to articulate how security services support compliance objectives. Understanding of merchant security and payment ecosystem is highly valuable.
  • Strong partnership development experienceincludingvendor relationships, channel partnerships, and strategic alliances. Track record of negotiating win-win partnerships that drive revenue growth.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to translate complex security concepts into business value and ROI. Experience with analyst briefings, conference speaking, and thought leadership.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen with P&L management experience or strong financial literacy.Understanding ofSaaS/managed services business models, unit economics, and pricing strategies.
  • Experience managing outsourced service provider relationships with focus on customer outcomes, performance management, and continuous improvement.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. Ability to build new offerings and enter new markets while maintaining operational excellence.
  • Data-driven approach to decision making with experience using CRM systems, business intelligence tools, and metrics dashboards to track performance and optimize strategies.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent demonstrating credible security expertise. Product management or sales certifications are valuable additions.
  • Established network in cybersecurity industry including relationships with security vendors, industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester), potential partners, and peer security leaders.

The role focuses primarily on Power BI development and platform administration, alongside a strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and ETL/ELT processes. You will collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver maintainable reporting solutions and support the evolution of the company's data architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports using DAX and Power Query (M).
  • Build and optimize data models to ensure reporting accuracy and performance.
  • Administer the Power BI environment, including datasets, workspaces, gateways, and service accounts.
  • Manage Power BI access, licensing, refresh failures, and platform-related issues.
  • Implement and maintain Row-Level Security (RLS) and data governance controls to meet security and audit requirements.
  • Document dashboard logic, data sources, business definitions, and reporting processes.
  • Gather and clarify reporting requirements with business stakeholders and translate them into maintainable BI solutions.
  • Work with SQL and relational databases to support reporting and data analysis.
  • Apply data warehouse concepts and dimensional modeling principles, including star and snowflake schemas.
  • Understand ETL/ELT processes and how data pipelines feed BI reporting layers.
  • Support the evolution of Power BI architecture as new data sources and semantic models are introduced through the Data Warehouse initiative.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Power BI development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in DAX, Power Query (M), and data modeling.
  • Strong SQL and Advanced SQL skills, with experience working with relational databases.
  • Solid understanding of data warehouse concepts and dimensional modeling, including star and snowflake schemas.
  • Working knowledge of ETL/ELT processes and their integration with BI reporting.
  • Practical experience implementing Row-Level Security (RLS) and data governance practices.
  • Experience with Power BI platform administration, including workspaces, datasets, gateways, and refresh management.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Fluency in both Arabic and English, spoken and written.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst certification (PL-300) or equivalent.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience working in a BI environment undergoing a Data Warehouse implementation or platform migration.

Job Title: Cybersecurity Architect

Job Location: Atlanta, GA

Job Location Type: Remote

Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at . Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn,Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.


Job Description

This is a technical role responsible for executing the design, building, testing, and implementation of security systems across our environment, with a specific emphasis on endpoint security and mobility. You will work closely with other members of the Information Security team to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities and develop strategies and solutions to mitigate these risks, securing the end-user device estate and the mobile platforms through which the enterprise increasingly operates, and contributing to our overall information security strategy.

This position can be virtual anywhere in the U.S.

You will join the Business Technology Solutions (BTS) Information Security and Risk Management (ISRM) Architecture organization. Our team translates business objectives and cyber risk strategy into concrete security measures — processes, technologies, and services — across a diverse and complex infrastructure landscape, including on-premises, cloud, and X-as-a-Service models.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and evaluate security architecture for the end-user device estate — workstation and laptop hardening, EDR/endpoint protection (e.g., CrowdStrike, Defender), data protection, and configuration baselines.
  • Advise on mobility security: MDM/UEM (e.g., Microsoft Intune), mobile application management, conditional access, and BYOD posture across iOS and Android.
  • Perform Security Architecture Reviews — adjudicate submissions, align the risk and controls with the system owner, and ensure review quality.
  • Deliver Security Architecture Consulting engagements with business partners — own each engagement end to end, with timely turnaround and clear customer communication.
  • Provide Risk Evidence Review on request, partnering with Risk Management to evaluate control and mitigation effectiveness for risk owners.
  • Plan, design, build, and implement enterprise security architecture, and create relevant documentation of same.
  • Evaluate security technologies and controls across the environment — including those employed by third-party providers — developing strategies, determining which controls fit a given situation, and adapting them to business needs, risk, and the threat landscape.
  • Identify and communicate current and emerging security threats and risks; design security architecture elements and propose new or revised measures to mitigate them as they emerge.
  • Help develop solutions that balance information security needs with the needs of the business, in collaboration with team members and business and IT stakeholders.
  • Be fluent with AI concepts and incorporate AI into your daily workflows — using AI to accelerate design reviews, threat modeling, documentation, and analysis — targeting improved efficiency, quality, and speed.
  • Create reusable security-architecture artifacts — reference architectures, design patterns, security guidelines, and security positions — that scale the team's expertise beyond one-off engagements.
  • Identify recurring problems and build durable systems, patterns, and standards that solve them at the root — not only technical problems, but process and people problems too — so the same issue does not keep resurfacing.
  • Support training and mentorship of more junior employees as well as employees outside the Information Security Team, as needed.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience OR Master's Degree and 7 years of experience OR PhD and 3 years of experience.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with security controls and concepts.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST, CIS Controls, OWASP, Cloud Security Alliance).
  • Advanced knowledge of operating systems, networking protocols, systems administration, and security technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge and application of cybersecurity terminology and concepts, and foundational understanding of the cyber threat landscape and attack vectors.
  • Understanding of risk management principles and the ability to integrate them into security practices.
  • Capable of learning new concepts and processes quickly and adapting to a constantly changing environment.
  • Fluency with AI concepts and demonstrated use of AI tools to improve how you work.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking, problem solving, and analytical skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a high level of professionalism.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively as part of a team.
  • Willingness to be available, as needed, for major and critical security issues.
  • Demonstrated skills and experience in the following tools:
    • Endpoint protection and detection (EDR/EPP), data protection, and configuration-baseline tooling.
    • Mobile device and endpoint management (MDM/UEM, e.g., Microsoft Intune), mobile application management, and conditional access.
    • Operating systems, networking protocols, systems administration, and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).
    • Security control frameworks and the cyber threat landscape and attack vectors.
    • AI tools and AI-assisted workflows to drive speed and quality.
    • Collaboration and documentation platforms (ServiceNow ITSM, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft 365 / SharePoint)

Preferred:

  • Professional cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, SANS/GIAC, etc.) are highly desirable.

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​

  • We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​

  • This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs. ​

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.​

Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Akron

Job Location: Work at Home, Ohio, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

29.5

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$105.00 - $105.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

Payroll Supervisor (Full-Time, Remote)

Remote — United States | Full-Time | $65,000 – $70,000 / year

Ensemble Performing Arts is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and people-focused Payroll Supervisor to join our Finance team and lead payroll operations across our growing portfolio of performing arts businesses. This role oversees the payroll team, ensures accurate and timely processing across multiple pay schedules, and safeguards payroll reporting and regulatory compliance.

This is the right fit for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment, enjoys coaching a team, and takes pride in maintaining accuracy and compliance in payroll operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
    • Supervise and develop payroll coordinators, setting priorities and workloads around each pay cycle
    • Review work for accuracy, provide regular feedback, and conduct performance reviews
    • Serve as the escalation point for complex payroll issues, employee inquiries, and manager questions
    • Oversee the payroll group inbox to ensure timely, accurate responses
  • Payroll Processing
    • Oversee end-to-end processing of weekly, biweekly, and semi-monthly payrolls for hourly and salaried employees
    • Review timekeeping data, overtime, shift differentials, bonuses, commissions, and retro adjustments before each run
    • Approve payroll registers, resolve discrepancies, and release payments, including direct deposits, paper checks, and off-cycle payments
    • Process garnishments, child support orders, and other deductions accurately and on schedule
    • Ensure timely, accurate processing of adjustments and final pay
  • Reporting & Reconciliation
    • Reconcile payroll to the general ledger and coordinate with Accounting on journal entries and accruals
    • Prepare payroll reports, such as labor cost, headcount, and overtime, for Finance and HR leadership
    • Maintain controls that protect confidential employee and compensation data
  • Tax & Compliance
    • Ensure compliance with the FLSA and federal, state, and local wage-and-hour, payroll tax, and reporting requirements
    • Oversee payroll tax deposits, quarterly filings (Form 941 and state equivalents), and year-end W-2/1099 processing
    • Stay current on regulatory changes and update procedures and system settings as needed
    • Support internal and external audits with clear documentation
  • Systems & Process Improvement
    • Administer the payroll system and partner with HR and IT on upgrades, integrations, and data accuracy
    • Document procedures and identify opportunities to automate and streamline processes

Who You Are

  • A people leader: you coach and develop your team, set clear priorities, and give feedback that helps people grow
  • Compliance-minded: you know multi-state payroll and wage-and-hour rules, and you stay ahead of changes
  • Accurate and detail-oriented: you catch discrepancies before payroll is released, not after
  • A process improver: you document, streamline, and automate so the team can do more, more consistently
  • Discreet and trustworthy: you protect sensitive employee and compensation data

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with core payroll functions, including 2+ years in a lead or supervisory role
  • Working knowledge of multi-state payroll and wage-and-hour compliance
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and lead a team
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and reconciliations
  • Excellent communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with Paylocity is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation range for this position is 65,000–70,000 per year, commensurate with experience. A competitive benefits package is provided, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and AD&D coverage; supplementary/voluntary benefit plans; Paid Time-Off; and a 401(k) with employer match.

To Apply

Please submit the following:

  • A resume
  • A brief cover letter outlining your interest in this role
  • Responses to our short questionnaire about your background. Applications without a cover letter and questionnaire response will be considered incomplete and will not be reviewed.

Diversity is a strength of our community. If you meet most but not all of the qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

About Ensemble Performing Arts

Ensemble Performing Arts, a four-time Inc. 5000 honoree, is one of the fastest-growing platforms of independently-run performing arts schools and businesses in the United States. We are powered by passionate educators and supported by a team that believes in preserving what makes each school and business unit special. With a multi-state, multi-entity footprint and active M&A pipeline, we are committed to operational excellence and a people-first culture grounded in respect, flexibility, and shared purpose. We offer opportunities for growth and leadership in a fast-scaling organization.

Who We Are

Our mission is to empower artists by safeguarding the businesses that love them ♡. Our values include:

  • Stewardship: We are caretakers of our performing arts businesses and communities, helping them thrive by making it easy for our teams and educators to cultivate an enriching experience for the students we serve.
  • Growth: Our performing arts businesses are integral to our success, and we are committed to their professional growth. As an ever-growing partnership across the performing arts education space, we seek to increase the high-quality resources provided to our businesses and the people who run them.
  • Stagehands: Our Shared Services team runs in the background to support our businesses. By doing this, we champion students to be the real stars of the show!

To learn more about Ensemble Performing Arts, visit .

Ensemble Performing Arts is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status or disability status, or genetic information. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with applicable law. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Salary: $65,000 – $70,000 / year

The Opportunity

We are supporting an established technology business within the public transportation sector in the appointment of a Business Development Manager to help drive continued growth across the US market.

This is a customer-focused sales position combining new business development with the growth and development of existing customer relationships.

The successful candidate will initially focus on opportunities within the mass transit and fare collection market, while also helping the business expand into adjacent sectors, including higher education.

This would suit a commercially driven sales professional who understands how to develop long-term customer relationships and navigate complex sales opportunities, particularly within public sector or technology-led environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop new business opportunities across the US market.
  • Grow and develop relationships with existing transit customers.
  • Identify new opportunities within mass transit, fare collection and related markets.
  • Help expand the company's presence within adjacent markets, including higher education.
  • Build relationships with key customer stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Develop strategic account plans for both existing and prospective customers.
  • Manage opportunities through the complete sales lifecycle.
  • Identify upcoming projects, procurements and RFP opportunities.
  • Support and coordinate responses to RFPs and other formal procurement processes.
  • Work closely with internal teams to develop appropriate customer solutions and commercial proposals.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of customer requirements, market developments and potential new opportunities.

Experience & Skills

We are looking for someone with:

  • Proven experience in business development, sales or account management.

  • Experience working with RFPs, tenders or formal procurement processes.
  • The ability to manage longer and potentially complex sales cycles.
  • A proactive approach to identifying and developing new opportunities.

Experience within mass transit, public transportation, fare collection, ticketing or a related public sector market would be particularly valuable, but we are also interested in strong sales professionals from adjacent technology-led markets.

raw.title: Co-Founder - CEO - Entrepreneur (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: Wir sind Startup Ideators, Company Evolvers und Problem Solvers: Als Co-Founder und Pre-Seed-Investor bauen wir Startups mit einer klaren Exit-Strategie.
raw.description:
Wir sind Startup Ideators, Company Evolvers und Problem Solvers: Als Co-Founder und Pre-Seed-Investor bauen wir Startups mit einer klaren Exit-Strategie. Unsere Motivation ist es, mit neuen Geschäftsmodellen, Produkten und Dienstleistungen die Startup Landschaft und den Wirtschaftsstandort Deutschland zu stärken und maßgeblich zu prägen.
Wir sind nicht nur Investor, sondern auch Co-Founder und investieren in außergewöhnliche Gründer: vom optimalen Matching des Gründerteams (bestehend aus CEO und COO) über die Entwicklung der Idee zu einem validierten Geschäftsmodell bis hin zur Sicherung des Seed-Investments. Als Partner auf Augenhöhe bieten wir ein einzigartiges Framework für das Setup, unterstützen die Produktentwicklung und -finanzierung und ermöglichen so, einen erfolgreichen Markteintritt. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir zum Breakeven-Point – bis hin zum EXIT. Das Fundament von BREAKEVEN bildet ein Team mit Synergien aus über 50 Jahren als Unternehmer, Seriengründer und Investoren. Auf diese Expertise greifen wir zurück, wenn wir junge ambitionierte Gründer auf dem Weg zum Erfolg begleiten.
Für weitere neue Startups suchen wir nun Talente mit digitalem Background und Hands-on-Mentalität als Co-Founder in der Position des Chief Executive Officer (CEO), die smarte Geschäftsideen gemeinsam mit uns erfolgreich am Markt platzieren und erfolgreich zum Exit führen.
Aufgaben
Du wirst mit weitreichenden Geschäftsführer-Kompetenzen ausgestattet und übernimmst die Führung sowie die Gestaltung des Unternehmens in einer Doppelbesetzung. Komplementär zum COO (verantwortlich für die Auftragsabwicklung), wirst du als CEO zuständig für alle Bereiche sein, die der Auftragsanbahnung zuzuordnen sind. Von Sales über Business Development bis hin zum Marketing bist du federführend.
Als CEO bist du ein wesentlicher Teil des Co-Founder-Teams und übernimmst unternehmerische Verantwortung für das Unternehmen.
  • Du stützt das profitable und nachhaltige Wachstum durch die Implementierung und Optimierung starker, belastbarer und skalierbarer Sales- und Marketingprozesse.
  • Du kümmerst dich um den Aufbau von KPI-Systemen zur Unterstützung einer datengetriebenen Sales- und Marketingsteuerung.
  • Du bist verantwortlich für den Gesamtumsatz, treibst eigenverantwortlich das Umsatzwachstum voran und überwachst die Sales-Pipeline.
  • Du treibst proaktiv den Aufbau von Partnerschaften mit relevanten Akteuren in der Branche voran.
  • Du baust sukzessive ein performance-orientiertes Sales- und Marketing Team auf ohne dabei die Kosten aus dem Blick zu verlieren.

Voraussetzungen

  • Dich zeichnen eine stark ausgeprägte unternehmerische Denkweise und exzellente organisatorische sowie analytische Fähigkeiten aus.
  • Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, vorzugsweise im wirtschaftlichen Bereich, mit ausgeprägten kaufmännischen Kenntnissen.
  • Du bringst eigene unternehmerische Erfahrungen im digitalen Startup-Umfeld als Unternehmer oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb oder Marketing – gern im Venture-Umfeld (Startup, VC) ­– mit.
  • Du hast ein „Entrepreneurial-Mindset“, hervorragende Kommunikations- und Führungsfähigkeiten, hohe Eigenmotivation und packst gern mit an, denkst lösungsorientiert und arbeitest vorausschauend.
  • Du konntest bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Personalverantwortung sammeln.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine zielorientierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise aus und reagierst flexibel auf sich ändernde Situationen.
  • Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind hervorragend.​

Vorteile

  • Große Verantwortung durch eigenständigen Aufbau und die Leitung eines Startups im digitalen Segment
  • Arbeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld und regelmäßiges Feedback/Coaching von erfahrenen Gründern und Geschäftsführern von Startups sowie Beiräten und Interimsmanagern
  • Kontinuierliche Unterstützung durch unser Venture Development
  • Attraktive Equity Beteiligung.
Wenn dich diese Herausforderung anspricht, du das Zeug zu einem CEO & Vollblutunternehmer mitbringst und bereit bist, ein hohes Arbeitspensum und Abstriche beim Gehalt in Kauf zu nehmen, um dafür aber mit einem hochmotivierten Team ein lukratives Startup aufzubauen, dann freuen wir uns, von dir zu hören.

Home-based


IQVIA is currently looking to recruit an experienced Virtual Key Account Manager for our client to support GP education and awareness of a new testing pathway in women's health.


Your primary responsibility will be to educate GP practices on appropriate testing pathways and drive the adoption of a new testing solution within women's health.

  • Strong virtual engagement skills.

About the Role: Provide speech and language therapy services to students in K-12 school settings. You'll conduct assessments, develop treatment plans, and deliver direct therapy to help students improve communication skills and access their education. This role collaborates closely with teachers, families, and multidisciplinary teams to maximize student outcomes.


Why Join Us:

  • CEU/license reimbursement and tuition assistance
  • Full benefits: that continue through all 12 months of the year (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • 401(k) with a company match
  • Paid sick leave, holidays, and vacation

What You'll Do:

  • Develop and coordinate treatment plans with interdisciplinary team members
  • Provide direct speech therapy services aligned with IEP goals
  • Complete and maintain compliant IEPs; participate in annual and triennial reviews
  • Consult with teachers and families to support generalization of communication skills
  • Maintain accurate therapy notes, assessment data, and progress documentation
  • Supervise and support SLPAs, including monitoring supervision hours (if applicable)

What We're Looking For:

Must Have:

  • Master’s degree in Speech-Language Pathology or Communication Sciences and Disorders from an accredited program.
  • DOJ/FBI Live Scan background and TB clearance
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication

Preferred:

  • One year of experience in speech therapy
  • Department of Education certification
  • Knowledge of evidence-based practices and special education programs
  • Experience with school-based caseload management

About Pacific Coast Speech Services, A Member of Point Quest Group: Point Quest Group is a leading national provider of special education services, partnering with 350+ school districts to help students with unique needs thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. Everything we do starts with one unwavering commitment: students first.

raw.title: Sr. Director, Regional Sales, South - Intismeran
raw.excerpt: The RoleModerna continues to expand its innovative mRNA platform, unlocking new applications across diseases and therapeutic areas.
raw.description:
The Role

Moderna continues to expand its innovative mRNA platform, unlocking new applications across diseases and therapeutic areas. As the company advances its oncology pipeline, including intismeran autogene, a personalized investigational mRNA therapy being developed in collaboration with Merck, this role will play a critical part in preparing for the potential launch of Moderna’s first commercial therapeutic in oncology.

Moderna’s intismeran autogene (INT) program represents an exciting advancement in personalized cancer treatment, leveraging the power of mRNA technology to develop therapies tailored to each patient’s unique tumor profile. This innovative approach has the potential to redefine the future of cancer care and marks a significant milestone in Moderna’s evolution beyond infectious diseases. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the commercial launch of a pioneering oncology program and play a foundational role in building Moderna’s oncology business.

Moderna is seeking a Sr. Director, Regional Sales, South, who will build, lead, and develop the South Region Oncology Sales team to drive regional sales strategy and execution for a co-promoted solid tumor oncology asset. This role is accountable for regional sales performance, oncology launch excellence, performance management and field execution across complex account ecosystems, while partnering closely with an alliance partner. The role requires deep expertise in oncology, and knowledge of account dynamics, experience building high performing teams, strong communication skills, analytical skills, ability to execute while partnering closely with the alliance, as well as proven leadership in a launch environment. This position is also responsible for building key business relationships with multi-disciplinary stakeholders across key health systems, accounts and large practice networks.

You combine strong sales and people leadership expertise with deep oncology knowledge and are comfortable partnering with alliance or other matrix partners to drive solutions that are best for patients and business. You are a collaborative thinker who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments and brings a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

Here’s What You’ll Do

  • Establish and lead the South Region Oncology Sales team, recruiting and developing sales professionals to deliver on sales goals and performance KPIs through effective product communication, execution of brand strategy, and collaboration with internal and alliance partners.
  • Develop and execute regional strategic account plans that leverage market insights to strengthen customer relationships, achieve sales targets, and facilitate growth within targeted accounts to support the successful launch of intismeran.
  • Collaborate internally and with our alliance partner to ensure effective, coordinated engagement of key accounts, and account leadership, compliantly tailoring the brand strategy to influence value drivers within each account.
  • Expertise in clinical data, disease state, and account management to provide direction to the field team and insights to the commercial organization.
  • Identify market trends and opportunities and proactively communicate with Oncology leadership.
  • Develop a high-performance culture by consistently providing coaching, performance management, and ongoing development for field teams.
  • Lead from the front through the frequent engagement of customers while partnering with the sales team exemplifying the skills, behaviors and attitude required to be successful by selling an innovative product in a complex environment and creating a culture of continuous learning and development.
  • Use data and digital tools to prioritize opportunities and monitor field performance, adapting quickly to emerging trends or needs.
  • Represent Moderna at high-level external engagements, including conferences, scientific forums, and engagements with key oncology stakeholders.
  • Partner as a peer with cross-functional leads across Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and the alliance ensuring a high level of communication and coordination to foster a positive customer experience.
  • Manage and deploy resources to ensure the achievement of objectives and manage regional budgets to ensure appropriate utilization of funds.
  • Ensure full compliance with Moderna policies and all applicable healthcare laws and regulations.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s Degree required·
  • Minimum of 10 years of pharmaceutical/biotech commercial experience, with demonstrated experience in oncology and field account strategy
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading oncology sales teams
  • Ability to travel up to 75%
  • Must reside within the assigned geographic region

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leading product launches in oncology
  • Prior experience in melanoma is highly preferred
  • Experience successfully launching and executing in an alliance relationship is highly preferred
  • Proven experience building high performing teams
  • Deep knowledge of key customer types including academic, community, IDN, and GPO affiliated oncology programs
  • Demonstrated background leading teams focused on account management while selling complex products and engaging multiple account stakeholders and specialties
  • Experience working in a solution oriented, dynamic, startup environment
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with cross function partners to ensure the appropriate coordinated engagement of all account types
  • Proven ability to utilize market knowledge and analytics to drive regional strategies, effective targeting, and achievement of sales goals
  • Fluency in data-driven decision-making and CRM utilization for field strategy
  • High adaptability, solution-oriented mindset, comfort operating in ambiguity and a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape
  • Exceptional interpersonal, leadership, communication and influencing skills
  • A desire to make an impact as part of a high-growth, transformational company that is Bold, Relentless, Curious, and Collaborative

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
  • Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
  • Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $196,700.00 - $353,400.00(for positions that may be performed in California, the expected salary range is $288,300.00 - $331,700.00, which reflects the range permitted under California Labor Code requirements) . This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs.The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, other incentive compensation, or equity award, subject to company plan eligibility criteria and individual performance.

About Moderna

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.


By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.


We are proud to have been recognized as a Science Magazine Top Biopharma Employer, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in the U.S.


If you want to make a difference and join a team that is changing the future of medicine, we invite you to visit modernatx.com/careers to learn more about our current opportunities.


Equal Opportunities

Moderna is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry or citizenship, ethnicity, disability, military or protected veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital or familial status, or any other personal characteristic protected under applicable law. Moderna is a place where everyone can grow. If you meet the Basic Qualifications for the role and you would be excited to contribute to our mission every day, please apply!


Moderna is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.


Accommodations

We’re focused on attracting, retaining, developing, and advancing our employees. By cultivating a workplace that values diverse experiences, backgrounds, and ideas, we create an environment where every employee can contribute their best.


Moderna is committed to offering reasonable accommodations to qualified job applicants with disabilities. raw.description:
The District Sales Manager (DSM) is an individual contributor responsible for delivering $20–$40M in annual revenue within a defined set of accounts and/or geographic region. One of the regions of focus will be South Central US, Canada, and/or commercial accounts across the US. This role is highly execution-focused, driving growth through new product adoption, dealer development, and increased share of wallet across a diverse network of 20–40 dealers and/or commercial contractors. The DSM partners closely with dealers ranging from small independent operators to large, multi-location organizations. Success in this role requires disciplined execution, strong relationship management, and the ability to translate strategy into measurable results in the field. The DSM reports to a Sales Manager and plays a key role in supporting broader regional and national sales objectives.

Your Impact & Responsibilities

Territory Execution & Revenue Delivery

  • Own and deliver revenue targets of $20–$40M within an assigned territory
  • Maintain a disciplined operating cadence to track performance, identify gaps, and drive corrective action
  • Provide accurate forecasting, pipeline visibility, and performance tracking
  • Use data to prioritize activities and improve decision-making
  • Deliver consistent communication on territory performance, risks, and opportunities

Dealer Management & Development

  • Manage a portfolio of 20–40 dealers, balancing attention across varying size and capability levels
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with dealer principals, sales teams, and key decision-makers
  • Improve dealer performance through consistent engagement, coaching, and alignment to company priorities
  • Support annual dealer planning, including goal setting, growth initiatives, and performance expectations
  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard new dealers aligned with strategic territory needs
  • Ensure new dealers are effectively onboarded and positioned for success

Execute Growth Strategies

  • Identify and execute opportunities to increase product penetration within existing dealers
  • Analyze dealer performance to uncover gaps and growth opportunities
  • Drive accountability with dealers to expand their commitment and results
  • New Product Adoption

◦ Lead in-territory rollout and adoption of new products ◦ Ensure dealers are trained, equipped, and actively promoting new offerings ◦ Provide structured field feedback to improve product-market fit and execution

Your Experience and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of sales or territory management experience
  • Proven ability to manage and grow a multi-million-dollar territory
  • Experience working with dealer or distribution networks strongly preferred
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to engage both small operators and larger, more complex organizations
  • Excellent communication, relationship management, and organizational skills

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base Salary: $90,000 - $110,000 annually, plus sales-based commission.

(Compensation depends on experience, territory performance, and technical capability.)

• Comprehensive benefits package including:

◦ Health, dental, and vision insurance ◦ 401(k) with company match ◦ Paid holidays and PTO ◦ Continuing education reimbursement ◦ Life and supplemental insurance options ◦ Flexible and hybrid work options where available

Workplace and Travel

This position is classified as remote/field-based, with travel within designated territory to meet with dealers, commercial contractors, end users, and internal teams. Occasional travel to manufacturing and engineering sites is required. Expected travel to be 50% - 80%. One of the regions of focus will be South Central US, Canada, and/or commercial accounts across the US.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a company that is transforming the grain industry through reliability, speed, and innovation.
  • Help shape how we serve dealers, commercial builders, farmers, and Co-Op customers, improving coordination and trust in every project.
  • Contribute to our Purpose: Feeding the World Better by enabling safer, more efficient, and more profitable grain systems.
  • Work within a “Winners Win” culture that values teamwork, accountability, and balanced success for employees, customers, and owners.

About Grain & Protein Technologies Grain & Protein Technologies is a leading global designer, manufacturer, and marketer of innovative solutions for grain storage, handling, and conditioning, as well as poultry, egg, and swine production systems. With operations in over 100 countries and 19 manufacturing facilities, we proudly serve farmers, agribusinesses, and commercial contractors who build the infrastructure that feeds the world.

Join us as we redefine service and partnership in the commercial grain market. Apply now to build what feeds the world.

Grain & Protein Technologies is a leading global designer, manufacturer, and marketer of reliable, durable, and innovative equipment solutions for grain, seed, poultry, egg, and swine production. Generating $1.1 billion in annual revenue, the Company serves farmers and agribusiness managers in over 100 countries and currently operates 19 manufacturing facilities across 5 continents, employing more than 3600 people. The Company goes to market with its strong portfolio of industry leading brands – GSI, Cumberland, AP, Tecno, Cimbria, Aerotech, Reventa, and Euroemme. With its Company Purpose of “Feeding the World Better”, Grain & Protein Technologies emphasizes advancing smart technologies and offering innovative technical solutions to make farmers and agribusiness managers more productive and profitable in a sustainable way.

Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at . Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn,Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.


Job Description

Purpose

Describe the primary goals, objectives or functions or outputs of this position.

The Account Specialist role promotes a product to community practices and health systems. Customer accounts may include community/private practices, community-based hospitals, academic medical centers, and government accounts (military treatment facilities and/or Veteran’s Affairs Medical Centers). The Account Specialist develops and maintains relationships with various accounts/departments such as neurology, pain medicine, physical medicine and rehabilitation, primary care, and pharmacy. Or in Urology, specialists such as urology, urogynecology, obstetrics and gynecology, female pelvic medicine, ambulatory surgical centers, and reconstructive surgery.

Responsibilities

  • Promote a product to meet/exceed sales goals in community/private practices as well as hospitals/health systems.
  • Identify/uncover customer needs (training, clinical, operational, reimbursement) and address with appropriate AbbVie resources
  • Provide education and clinical/injection training for residents, fellows, and other key hospital personnel.
  • Expert delivery of anatomical/procedural information and training, including the appropriate use of anatomical terminology to train injection paradigms/postures while highlighting various anatomical and injection insights and considerations.
  • Effectively utilize AbbVie's sales and data resources to enhance productivity and growth of AbbVie products while implementing U.S. Marketing Plan.
  • Collaborate with other Account Specialist to promote the product for approved indications and execute individual, department, or group resident/fellow trainings within hospital/health system accounts.

Qualifications

Qualifications

List required and preferred qualifications (up to 10). Include education, skills and experience.

  • Bachelor’s degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
  • Relevant and equivalent industry experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree is at least five (5) years of technical experience with three (3) or more years of experience within sales preferred and a high school diploma/GED required
  • Experience with Buy & Bill and/or Specialty Pharmacy products is preferred, in both health systems and private practice
  • Ability to lift/pull 25 - 100 lb. training models and meet necessary hospital credentialing/vaccination requirements
  • Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements
  • Ability to travel adequately to cover territory, as well as overnight attendance at scheduled training events and sales meetings
  • Documented history of strong sales performance, preferably in a clinical/technical/consultative sales role with multiple decision makers is preferred. Ability to manage a complex sell, learn procedural, technical, clinical, and anatomical information quickly and communicate/present/train to a variety of audiences
  • An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
  • These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements and for any associated liability for failing to do so. AbbVie has resources available to you to help answer questions you may have.

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on manyfactors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​

  • We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​

  • This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentive programs. ​

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount isearned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that areallocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolutediscretion, consistent with applicable law. ​

About NLA and TCS

New Left Accelerator (NLA) and its 501(c)(3) affiliate, The Capacity Shop (TCS), lead operational capacity-building programs that empower social justice organizations and movements to execute bold work safely. We bridge the gap between ambitious strategy and operational excellence, scaling structures and impact without sacrificing legal compliance or integrity. To achieve systemic change, organizations must use every tool in their toolbox effectively—including multi-entity structures.

Through deep collaboration with field experts, we build the financial and compliance training systems that allow movement organizations to manage risk and remain resilient. Our work is rooted in a commitment to:

  • Power Building For Systemic Change: Equipping organizations to build power to dismantle oppressive structures.
  • Operational Power: Building the "operational" capacity to execute bold work and to strategically manage risk.
  • A Multi-Entity Lens: Optimizing the diverse legal structures necessary to win critical battles.
  • Transformative Partnerships: Prioritizing those working at the intersections of race, gender, and class.

At NLA, our work is guided by a Theory of Change. We accompany organizations and movements in building sustainable, resilient ecosystems prepared to win the most ambitious fights of our time.

Overview of Project

Background

NLA and TCS develop training on a range of operations topics, focused on what multi-entity organizations need to know. We are developing foundational content for a training module for HR staff at mid-size, multi-entity social justice organizations that do election-year work. The content will focus on the HR issues specific to these organizations when they hire for organizing positions during an election cycle and then end those positions afterward.

Scope of Work

The HR Subject Matter Lead will work under the direction of the TCS, Senior Director of Training and Curriculum to develop a four-part, role-based education module for HR specialists. The module will:

  • Apply a nonprofit multi-entity Human Resources lens throughout
  • Apply a social justice lens to HR in the organizing and election year context
  • Build on existing NLA/TCS content
  • Incorporate NLA's learning frameworks and practices
  • Be customizable for state content

Deliverables and Outcomes

December 2026 through June 2027

  • Content Audit Report: An assessment of existing NLA/TCS HR content that sorts it into what can be used as is, what needs updating, and what's missing. It will include recommendations for the Content Lead.
  • Co-Design Program Line with NLA: Work with TCS and NLA staff to propose the format of the TCS HR pilot program line; consider implications for integration of content into other NLA/TCS program lines.
  • Module Design Proposal: A proposed outline for how we might break out role-based HR education modules segmenting existing content and identifying modifications or needed updates, propose for each training, learning objectives, key topics, and clarity which pre-existing source content that training will draw on and how content will hold together to create an integrated learning experience (define elements like office hours)
  • Training Materials (one set for each of the four trainings): Facilitator guides, slide decks, tools and resources and participant materials, all finalized with the NLA/TCS T&C and content team.
  • Supporting Tools & Resources: Work with content team to co-create HR focused tools, guides, and templates that go with each training in the module.
  • Delivery of Four Trainings (pilot): Conduct live training and facilitation of the module in collaboration with TCS training team; document what works and what does not for improvement.
  • Pilot Debrief and Revision Recommendations: A summary of what was learned from the pilots, with recommended changes. It will also include updated materials that reflect the changes the Content Lead approves.

Steers

  • Start with what exists. Adapt and strengthen current materials rather than redesigning by default.
  • Learn and apply the NLA/TCS competencies (Attitudes & Beliefs, Knowledge & Skills, People & Resources, Systems & Processes) as a diagnostic lens.
  • Prioritize practical application. Use realistic scenarios, decision points, and tools that participants can apply in their organizations.
  • Make distinctions clear. Identify when an issue is a routine management matter, an HR matter, or one that requires employment counsel or other specialized expertise.
  • Design for adult learners with varied levels of HR responsibility and experience. Ensure the content and guides are useful for organizations with limited HR infrastructure as well as those with dedicated HR staff.
  • Keep organizational decisions internal. The consultant will advise and develop content in partnership with staff; NLA/TCS retains final approval.
  • Keep the scope focused on content development, training delivery, and transfer. New legal research, state-by-state guidance, or broader HR consulting must be separately approved.
  • Engage in quality control process and help ensure accuracy and compliance of products

What We Are Looking For

  • 10 years HR experience within multi-entity election-cycle workforces, including employee relations, people management, HR operations, and employment compliance
  • Experience translating complex HR concepts into clear, practical training for non-HR audiences.
  • Training and curriculum development and adult-learning facilitation skills, including virtual training experience (can be public or within organizations).
  • Significant experience supporting movement-building organizations, especially 501(c)(3)s, 501(c)(4)s, campaigns, and/or PACs, with a strong understanding of shared staffing structures and multi-entity operations.
  • Ability to work with HR attorneys to translate legal advice into training content; ability to distinguish general HR education from legal advice and to flag areas requiring review by employment counsel and help manage compliance, accuracy and quality of content.
  • A collaborative working style and demonstrated ability to incorporate feedback without losing technical accuracy or instructional coherence.

Proposal Requirements

Please submit:

  • Letter of Interest (1 page maximum) that covers:
    • Your experience with multi-entity Human Resources including in an election year context.
    • Proposed approach to the scope of work and why you are best positioned to execute this work
    • A fee proposal, including your assumptions about level of effort (for example, estimated hours per deliverable)
  • Resume showing relevant experience in:
    • Human resources in the nonprofit, movement or social justice space, election-cycle settings
    • Curriculum and training development
    • Facilitation
    • Movement building
    • Multi-entity organizations (for example, 501(c)(3), 501(c)(4), and PAC structures)

Submission Information

  • Submissions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Priority deadline is November 6, 2026

Job Title: Strategic Project Lead, Coding/SWE

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

The Role

As a Strategic Projects Lead (SPL), you will own the end-to-end delivery of coding data pipelines used to train frontier AI models. You’ll work closely with AI Lab clients, software engineering experts, reviewers, and internal teams to ensure high-quality, scalable execution.

What You’ll Do

  1. Own end-to-end delivery of coding data pipelines, ensuring quality, timelines, and client alignment.
  2. Drive automation of pipeline workflows, including task generation, validation, QC, and reporting.
  3. Coordinate across experts, reviewers, MTS, and clients to maintain execution consistency and quality.
  4. Define task specifications, golden samples, and review rubrics to establish clear quality standards.
  5. Track and optimize pipeline health across quality, AHT, throughput, and delivery metrics.
  6. Lead continuous improvement based on client feedback, audits, and performance data.

What We’re Looking For

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  2. Strong understanding of software engineering and coding fundamentals.
  3. 2+ years leading technical projects, operations, or complex data workflows.
  4. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using metrics to drive improvements.
  5. Ability to translate client requirements into clear technical specifications and scalable workflows.
  6. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and client-facing teams.
  7. Startup mindset with a bias toward ownership, automation, and execution.

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $120,000 –$160,000 USD. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

raw.description:
Novakid is a global leader in online English education for children aged 4–12, serving 100,000+ students across 50+ countries. As Senior Product Manager for Monetization & Expansion, you will own how existing Novakid families discover and buy additional courses, products and services, and be fully accountable for the product metrics behind them, including added revenue and ARPU.

Your goal is to turn the Parent Area and other in-product touchpoints into a scalable self-service channel for add-ons and upgrades. You will own the product, offer, pricing and experimentation decisions that drive results, supported by our Revenue Growth Lead across Sales and CRM.

Senior Product Manager – Monetization & Expansion

Focus: Parent Area, Add-ons & Upgrades, Purchase Journeys, Monetization Experiments

What you’ll do

  • Work with a team of designers and developers (with access to analytical and research resources).

  • Own the roadmap for the Parent Area as a storefront for add-ons and upgrades: placement, merchandising, pricing visibility and one-tap purchase.

  • Improve purchase, upgrade and win-back journeys to lift conversion from offer view to paid.

  • Build configurable catalogue, bundling, pricing and promo logic so new offers launch without engineering effort each time.

  • Run the experimentation programme for offers, bundles and pricing, with clear guardrails on retention, refunds and parent satisfaction.

  • Define the product events and eligibility signals that power in-app nudges and CRM segments.

  • Work with Content and Pedagogy to discover, validate and launch new paid products that children learn from and parents value.

  • Adapt flows by market, balancing self-service and manager-assisted buying and local pricing conditions.

Requirements

What you’ll have

  • 4+ years’ experience in a PM role, including 2+ years owning monetization, pricing, checkout or subscription growth in a B2C subscription product.

  • A track record of shipping in-product upsell, cross-sell or add-on flows with measurable revenue impact.

  • Strong experimentation skills: test design, sample sizing, guardrails and honest readouts.

  • Understanding of subscription billing, entitlements and payment providers such as Stripe.

  • EdTech or family products experience, where parent and child are different users, is a strong plus.

  • You thrive in a 100% remote, distributed team environment (core hours GMT+3) and are a master of tools like JIRA and Slack.

  • Excellent spoken and written English.

What we offer

  • Fully remote work

  • A chance to shape the future of AI-driven education

  • A fun, dynamic team that loves building innovative products

  • Unlimited holidays, because we trust you to deliver
